['Insaan chahe zaalim ho ya masoom ... woh atyachar karne ke liye bandook uthaye ya atyachar mitaane ke liye ... kanoon ki nazaron mein mujrim ban jaata hai', 'Hindustani nariyan joh hoti hai chikni machliyon ki tarah hoti hai ... haath se phisal jaati hai', 'Aag petrol ko nahi chhodti ... nevla saanp ko nahi chhodta ... aur jab main paison ka hisaab jodhta hoon toh main apne baap ko nahi chhodta', 'Joh main dikhai deta hoon woh main nahi hoon ... aur joh hoon woh dikhai nahi deta', 'Meri aankhon ko gaur se dekh ... in mein tujhe teri chitta ki jalti hui aag dikhai degi ... tujhe teri astiyon ki raakh dikhai degi ... teri zindagi ko maine jis khaak mein mila diya tujhe woh khaak dikhai degi', 'Kisi ke kaan mein heera, kisi ki aankh mein heera ... mujhe heeron se kya lena, mera mehboob hai heera', 'Ladki ke dil mein vishvas ka diya jalane ke liye sirf Shammi Kapoor style mein ganaa gana kaafi nahi hota ... Dilip Kumar aur Raaj Kumar ki tarah emotional scene bhi karne padte hai', 'Hamari nazaren hamesha aasmaan ke sitaaron pe rehti hai ... zameen ki dhool hum mein pasand nahi', 'Joh samundar mein gotha lagate hai woh bheegkar jaate hai ... aur joh bar mein aate hai woh do-do peg peekar jaate hai', 'Lover ko pareshan karna Hindustani nariyon ki adayen hoti hai']

['Gunahghar us waqt tak mashoor rehta hai jab tak police dheel deti hai ... lekin jab police kanoon ki rassi kheenchti hai toh bade bade mujrimon ke gale mein phasi ka phanda hota hai', 'Bure waqt se badi khatarnak koi cheez nahi hai is duniya mein', 'Kagaz phadne se likhai mitt sakti hai lekin sachai nahi', 'Raajneeti ke mandi mein joh sabse sasti cheez bikti hai ... woh hai police', 'Hum hai police ki naak ke baal, insaaf ki dhaal, havaldar Bankelal ... chal do rupai nikaal', 'Main jis file ko kholta hoon na ... woh mujrim ko jail mein bandh karne ke baad hi bandh karta hoon', 'Meri fitrat hai goongo se bulvana, bhairon ko sunane ke liye majboor kar dena aur jhooton ki zubaan se sach ughalvana', 'Jab hum pehda hue the toh raat ke barah bajhe the ... aur raat ke barah bajhe sirf shaitan pehda hua karte hai', 'Aankh ka andha toh laathi ka sahara lekar tedhe-medhe raaston par bhi chal sakta hai ... lekin akal ka andha seedhe raaste par bhi thokar ka jaata hai', 'Main bhi kitna harami hoon, dono taraf dhol bajhata hoon ... udhar se maal kamata hoon, idhar se naam kamata hoon', 'Yahan ki fikar wahan ka khayal rakha hai ... badi ada se dono jahan sambhal rakha hai', 'Doobara is basti mein Baba Bhatti jab aayega toh zulm ki woh haddi bankar aayega ... joh tumhare gale mein aaise phasegi ... ki na tum usse nighal sakoge, na tum usse ughal sakoge', 'Pachees se tees baras tak ki umar ka pyar ... pukhta, sanjeeda, kisi bade maidan ke seene par behte hue dariya ki tarah gambhir aur shaant hota hai ... aur bees se ekkees ki umar mein ... kisi oonchi pahadi se girta hua apsar ki tarah gungunata hua, athkeliyan sa karta hua ... aur pandra se solah ki umar mein ... paakh, bechain, apne ird-gird ki har cheez se laparwah ... bilkul aapki tarah']

['Dushman ko maarne ke liye hosh aur awaaz chahiye ... josh aur junoon nahi', 'Insaan ko zindagi mein sab kuch mil toh nahi jaata ... tamannayein toh bahut hoti hai lekin sabhi poori nahi hoti ... fark sirf itna hai ki kuch log aansoon bahakar jeete hai aur kuch log apne dil ka dard chupakar jeete hai', 'Balle O balle ... mujrimon ki anjar panjar dhille ... mooh peele te kapde geele', 'Paon utne hi phailane chahiye jitni chaddar ho ... aur farz bhi utna hi nibhana chahiye jitni uski hadh ho', 'Hamara yaar toh kanoon ke liye jeeta hai ... vardi ke andar kanooni cheetah hai', 'Mera usool hai joh kanoon todne ki koshish kare uska haath todh doon ... joh kanoon ko challenge kare uske jabde todh doon ... taaki woh phir kabhi kanoon todne ki jurrat na kare', 'Duniya mein insaan sirf apne liye pehda nahi hua hai ... doosron ke liye jeekar dekho ... zindagi ka matlab samajh jaogi', 'Jazbaat ki chhot aur dil ka ghaav bahut gehra hota hai ... bahut dard hota hai us mein']

['Hum mein toh apno ne loota, gairon mein kahan dum tha ... meri kishti thi doobi wahan, jahan pani kam tha', 'Yeh desh sirf do hi logon pe hasta hai ... hijhron par aur hum policewaalon par ... kyun ki nah hi woh kuch kar sakte hai, aur nah hi hum kuch kar sakte hai', 'Dilwale toh bahut dekhe, lekin pyar mein joh pagal ho jaye ... aise dilwale ko aaj pehli baar dekha', 'Yeh aankhen, yeh chehra, yeh noor ... insaan ho ya pari ho tum', 'Hum Hindustani policewaale jahanum tak us shaksh ka peecha nahi chhodte ... joh is vardi ki beizzati karta hai', 'Mujhe aaina na dikhao, ismein koi pagal nazar aata hai ... yeh main nahin, ismein sara jahan nazar aata hai', 'Pyar toh usne kiya, humne to bas dillagi ki', 'Mohabbat mere dost, aag bhi lagati hai un dilon ko ... jin mein mohabbat ke chirag jalte hai', 'Yeh duniya hum mein milne nahi degi ... lekin main bhi ab is duniya ko jeene nahi doonga', 'Main bahar dhamki dekar aaya hoon ki joh aadmi pehle andar aayega ... main uski taange todh doonga', 'Amir toh duniya mein nafrat hi faylata hai ... par gareeb pyar laata hai', 'Uska toh main aisa hashar karoonga ... ki sunne waalo ki rooh kaanp uthegi']

['Jhoot ke haathon se khodi gayi kabar mein sachchai dafnayi nahi jayegi', 'Isne tumhe dekha angle badal badalke ... aur tumne isse maara sandal badal badalke', 'Jhoot ek vaishaya ki tarah hai ... jisse lakh parde mein rakho, magar uski asliyat nahi chupti', 'Humne wahan apna khoon bahaya jahan tera pasina nikla ... bade bhai se bhi badhkar samjha tujhe ... par saale tu toh bada kamina nikla', 'Woh copy hi kya jiska koi cover na ho ... aur woh ladki hi kya jiska koi lover na ho', 'Court ka ghar mein deri hai ... magar Bandra aur Andheri nahi', 'Woh mooch hi kya jisse phera na jaye ... aur woh husn hi kya jisse cheda na jaye']

['Daulat itni daulatmand nahi joh sacha pyar khareed sake', 'Ekka bhale hi sabse bada ho ... magar rani hamesha raja ki hoti hai', 'Falak ko zid hai jahan bijliyan girane ki ... hum mein bhi zid hai wahin apna aashiyan banane ki', 'Judai ke dard ka mol kabhi chukaya nahi ja sakta ... usse sirf samjha jaata hai', 'Main tumhe bada aadmi samajhta tha ... magar tum sirf amir nikle ... main tumhe apna bhai samjha ... magar tum sirf is shehar ke bhai nikle']

['Mere do do baap ... mere do do baap!', 'Aapki kalai ka naap le raha tha ... hathkadi ka order dene ke liye', 'Main marne se nahi darta ... is liye ki maut is zindagi se zyada bhayanak nahi ho sakti', 'Zaroori nahi hai ki jail mein rehne waala har insaan ... mujrim hota hai', 'Jurm hi uska pesha hai ... aur daulat uska dharm', 'Bhale zindagi mein mujhe koi medal na mile ... magar main is medal lagne waale vardi par, ek medal jitna chota daag bhi lagne nahi doonga', 'Saanp ke bil mein haath dalne waala ... uska zeher bhi uttarna jaanta hai']

['Log kehte hai khoobsurat ladkiyan jab jhoot bolti hai ... toh aur bhi khoobsurat lagti hai', 'Kyun ... hum aapke hain kaun?', 'Aaj pehli baar koi ladki ... hamari car ke front seat pe behti hai', 'Zindagi ki khasiyat hai yeh kabhi jhukti nahi ... saanse ruk jati hai magar zindagi rukti nahi', 'Bane chahe dushman zamana hamara, salamat rahe dostana hamara ... na bechre marke bhi hum doston, hum mein dosti ki kasam doston ... pata koi pooche toh kehte hai hum, ek dujhe ke dil mein rehte hai hum ... nahi aur koi thikana hamara, salamat rahe dostana hamara', 'Roop rang mein gori ho chahe kaali ho ... khushnaseeb woh jija hai jiski saali ho', 'Jab hum aapse kuch poochna chahe toh aap hum mein rokti hai ... aur jab chup ho jaye toh tokti hai', 'Arre kaka main toh kaka ban gaya']

['Hamare dhande mein dushman khatam nahi hote ... mehmaano ki tarah ek jaata hai toh doosra chala aata hai', 'Jitni himmat mujh mein goli chalane ki hai ... usse kahi zyada himmat goli khane ki hai', 'Sher jab ghayal ho jaata hai ... toh shikari ke liye maut ban jaata hai', 'Tutisha ka record hai ... uske tamachon ke nishaan gaal par se mitt jaate hai ... lekin dimaag par se nahi mittate']

['Avesh ho ya dukh ho, gussa ho ya khushi ... apni bhavnaon ko paanch minute tak roke rakho ... un paanch minuton mein mann shaant ho jayega ... aur shaant mann se lena waala har ek faisla achcha hi hoga', 'Pyar mein woh divya shakti hai joh patthar ko bhi maum bana de']

['Jab tumhari bhatakti hui rooh tumhare mulk pahunche ... toh ek ek shaitan se kehna ki dobara hamare desh ki taraf aankhen uthane ki jurrat na kare', 'Uthho jawaan-e-watan, bandhe huye sar se kafan ... uthho dakkhan ki aur se, Gang-o-Jaman ki aur se ... Punjab ke dil se uthho, Satluj ke sahil se uthho ... awaaz do hum ek hai, hum ek hai, hum ek hai', 'Yeh thappad tune mujhe nahi apni naukri ke mooh par maara hai ... apne khandan ke ek ek aadmi ki khushiyon par maara hai ... apni zindagi par maara hai', 'Girte hain sher savaar hi maidan-e-jung mein ... woh tiflya kya girega joh ghutno ke bal chale', 'Jahan kanoon ke haath pahunchne mein der ho jaye ... wahan kanoon ki laat pahunch jaya karti hai', 'Ek baar jab rishtey kho jaate hai ... toh woh dhoondne se bhi nahi milte']

['Kuch parinde aaise bhi hote hai joh halaat ke pinjre mein qaid toh hote hai magar majboor nahi hote ... unki baazuon mein itni taqat hoti hai ki woh pinjra samet udh jaate hai', 'Kathin pariksha mein pass ho jaana meri buri aadat hai', 'Jab dus kamine marte hai toh ek kutta pehda hota hai ... jab sau kutte marte hai toh ek soovar pehda hota hai ... aur jab ek hazaar soovar marte hai toh ek bhadwa pehda hota hai ... aur jab ek lakh bhadwe marte hai tab tujh jaisa ek ganda neta pehda hota hai', 'Main tumhare jism ko vardi ki jagah zakhmon ka libaaz pehna doonga ... aur phir tum dard se itna tadpoge ke uske baad maut ko bhi chakhoge toh yahi kahoge ke ... maaza nahi aaya', 'Yeh bhashan nahi yeh meri warning hai ... aur meri warning tumhare is cigarette case ke upar likhi hui warning ki tarah nahi ... jisse tum bhoolkar cigarette ke kash lagaya karte ho ... meri warning kanoon ke kitaab ke us full stop ki tarah hai ... jiske baad kuch bhi karne ya sochne ki jagah nahi bachti', 'Zaat duniya mein sirf do tarah ki hoti hai ... ek woh joh aasoon peeta hai, ek woh joh khoon peeta hai ... ek woh joh insaaniyat ko aabad karta hai, ek woh joh insaaniyat ko barbaad karta hai', 'Aadmi ke paas jis prakaar ka astra shastra ho ... ussi prakaar ka yudh ladna chahiye ... tabhi usko safalta milti hai', 'Imaandari woh ganja sar hai jispar noton ke baal kabhi ugh hi nahi sakte ... thodi si baimaani ki tel ki malish karte rehna chahiye', 'Agar tu ghar mein chupa raha toh chuhe ki maut maara jayega ... aur agar bahar nikal aaya toh geedar ki maut ... bol tujhe kaunsi maut chahiye?', 'Tumhe is baat ka koi haq na pahunchta ki police ki farz ki Ganga joh ki kanoon ki Gangotri se nikalti hai ... usse tum apni gandi aadaton ke gutter mein dal do', 'Joh log waqt ke dhaare mein kagaz ki naav ki tarah beh jaate hai ... unhe ek mamuli si lehar bhi dooba deti hai', 'Jab shehar ki taqdeer harami ho jaati hai ... tab Kapali jaisa ek haramzada pehda hota hai', 'Vidyarthi woh hote hai joh vidya ka arth nikaalte hai ... magar aap log toh vidya ki arthi nikaal rahe hai', 'Duty ek aaisi cheez hai joh kabhi kabhi rote huye bhi nibhani padti hai', 'Log toh sirf rupaiya aur izzat par daaka dalte hai ... magar tumne hamare vishvas par daaka daala hai', 'Jab logon ki bahaduri baanjh ho jaati hai ... tabhi Kapali jaise gunde pehda hote hai', 'Har woh kadam joh kanoon todne ke liye aage badega ... main usse apahij kar doonga', 'Joh imaandaron se gaddari karega ... woh gaddaron se imaandari karega', 'Chola aur kursi badal jaane se aadmi ki janam kundli nahi badalti', 'Main nafrat ke mohron se dushmani ka shatranj ussi ki bisaat pe khelonga ... aur aaisi maat doonga, aaisi maat doonga ki maut bhi roo padegi', 'Woh shaadi hi kya teri dawat nahi jis mein ... aur woh aag hi kya teri soorat nahi jis mein', 'Tum ghadi ki keemat toh jaante ho ... magar waqt ki keemat nahi jaante', 'Mere nasson mein khoon ke saath saath barood bhi behta hai ... aur aaj tujhe is barood ke dhamake bhi sunne padenge', 'Gundon ka rakhail kabhi gareebon ka rakhwaala nahi ban sakta', 'Tum meri zindagi mein full stop toh kya comma bhi nahi laga sake ... lekin main tumhari zindagi mein full stop zaroor lagaonga', 'Agar aap log yeh chahte hai ... ki aap logon ki khuddi ko mittane ke liye agar gundon ki khudai bhi aa jaye aur mitta na sake ... toh aap logon ko khuddar banna padega']

['Kutte ki tarah jeene ki aadat padhi hai sabko', 'Aa gaye meri maut ka tamasha dekhne', 'Saale apne khud ke desh mein ek sui nahin bana sakte ... aur hamara desh todne ka sapna dekhte hain', 'Yeh Musalman ka khoon yeh Hindu ka khoon ... bata is mein Musalman ka kaunsa Hindu ka kaunsa, bata!', 'Upar waala bhi upar se dekhta hoga toh usse sharam aati hogi ... sochta hoga maine sabse khoobsurat cheez banayi thi, insaan ... neeche dekha toh sab keede ban gaye ... keede!', 'Hum bhale hi upar waale ko alag alag naam se pukarte hai ... lekin hamara dharam ek hai mazhab ek hai ... insaniyat', 'Tumse toh woh vaishyan achchi hoti hai joh bechti zaroor hai, magar apna jism bechti hai ... apne desh ko, apni aatma ko, apne imaan ko nahi bechti', 'Hum tumhe aaise jalayenge ... ke tere chahne waalo ko Ganga mein bahane ke liye teri raakh bhi naseeb nahi hogi', 'Insaaf nahi mangne se milta hai aur nahi cheenne se ... aaj toh insaaf bikta hai, sirf bikta hai', 'Tumhare napaak kadam aage mat badaoo ... todhkar tumhare gaale mein pehna denge']

['Vasuli mein hum rupaye nahi ... samne waale ke maathe par pasine ki boondein ginte hai', 'Galatfahmi mein jeene waale ... asliyat mein mar jaate hai', 'Hum hai maut ki woh express ... duniya jise kehti hai Madam X', 'Humse dushmani modh lekar tumne zehareelay bichhoo ka dank apne shareer mein gaadh liya hai ... aur bichhoo ke dank se aadmi marta nahi hai ... zindagi bhar tadapta aur sisakta rehta hai ... tum bhi jab tak jeeoge tadapte aur sisakte hi rahoge', 'Koi hum mein maarkar hamara anth kya karega ... mitne waale nahi hai hum, koi hamara khaatma kya karega ... zindagi ko apni qaid mein liye ghoomte hai hum ... koi zindagi se hum mein juda kya karega', 'Main uske jism par itne zakhm kar doonga ... ki sirf zakhm hi zakhm nazar aayenge ... jism nahi', 'Shikaar ke waqt sherni jis zameen par apne khunkhar panje rakhti hai ... us zameen ko bhi uske chalne ka ehsaas nahi hota ... ehsaas tab hota hai jab shikaar kiya hua khoon zameen par bikhar jaata hai', 'Yeh kanoon ke woh baap hai joh apni duty ko apni gaud mein jhula jhulakar, usse pyari pyari lori sunakar sula dete hai ... aur aapke noton ka pankha banakar usse thandi thandi hawa dete hai', 'Kanoon hamari giraftari ka plan baad mein banata hai ... hum usse todne ke raaste pehle hi bana lete hai', 'Hamari saanson ki awaaz sunkar toh maut ke farishtay bhi gabrakar bhaag jaate hai', 'Hamare paas duniya par nazar rakhne waali itni aankhen hai ... jitni shayad aasman par sitaare bhi na ho', 'Jab bhi hamare samne koi bewakoof akalmandi ka taj pehenne ki jurrat karta hai ... toh taj toh uske haathon mein hota hai magar pehenne ke liye uska sar nahi hota', 'Yeh maut bhi kitni ajeeb cheez hai ... insaan usse mehsoos karte hi, zindagi ke aanchal mein chanchal balak ki tarah tadapne lagta hai', 'Dimaag ki aankh se dekhne waale ... chehre ki aankhon ka bahut kam istamal karte hai', 'Jis tarah yamraj ko sirf yamlok hi dekh sakta hai ... ussi tarah Madam X ki shakal bhi sirf uska apna samraj hi dekh sakta hai ... joh bhi hamari jhalak dekhne ki jurrat karta hai ... woh jalkar aaise dhuan ho jaata hai ki na zameen ko uski khaak milti hai, na hawaon ko uski raakh']

['Hume sirf ek take milta hai, sirf ek take ... aur agar uss ek take mein hamse koi galati ho jati hai ... toh maut ke samne zindagi ghutne take deti hai', 'Pata nahin kis gali kis nukkad kis chaurahe par ... kis goli kis chaku par mera naam likha hai', 'Pyar ki bhasha toh achche achche patthar dilon ko phigla deti hai', 'Raat ki samasya ... insaan ko raat ko hi suljhani chahiye', 'Film ho ya haqeeqat ... jab ladkiyo ko bachana hota hai ... toh hero hi aata hai', 'Inspector saab kanoon aur farz ke rakhwaale baad mein banna ... pehle dil ke rakhwaale bano', 'Tum ek achche khandan ki bigdi hui nasamajh aulad ho', 'Sachchai ke aasoon se dil pighla karte hai ... tum jaise patthar nahi', 'Chaand se maathe par chaandi jaise pasina kyun?']

['Dobara agar koi chaal chalne ki koshish ki toh main nahi bolunga ... meri AK47 bolegi', 'Barood ke dher par beth kar aag ka khel nahi khelte', 'Aankhen andar ka haal bata deti hai ... sirf padne wali nazar honi chahiye', 'Mujrim maa ke pet se janam nahin leta ... usse janam deta hai tumhara kanoon, tumhari police', 'Yeh toh aapne lakh rupaiye ki baat kahi haan', 'Mard ko abaad bhi aurat karti hai aur barbaad bhi aurat karti hai', 'Apno ko milne ke liye time nikalna padta hai', 'Is desh ke shehar shehar, gaon gaon mein, yahan tak ki ghar ghar ke andar nashe ko pohchane ki lagan honi chahiye hum mein', 'Bakra khud kasai ke ghar ke samne jaakar kathak karne laga ... toh use kaun bacha sakta hai?', 'Hamari tarakki ke raaste mein joh bhi aayega uski zubaan band karni hogi ... rupaiyon se nahin toh goli se', 'Najayaz kaam karna meri aadat nahi', 'Waqt sabse bada marham hota hai', 'Mujhe duniya ka sabse daulatmand aur sabse shaktishali insaan banna hai', 'Shayad aaj tak aisa koi mila hi nahin ... jise main apne zakhm dikha sakon', 'Insaan ki sabse badi guarantee uska apna zameer hota hai', 'Ek baar jab main faisla kar leta hoon toh, joh sochta hoon woh karta hoon ... joh chahta hoon woh paata hoon', 'Chaal pe chaal chalne ki meri aadat hai', 'Tumhari gardan ke naap ka phanda tayyar kar liya hai maine', 'Wahi jam jao, varna iski laash postmortem ke bhi layak nahi rahegi', 'Kal ke baad is mulk ke nasal ki ragoon mein khoon nahin ... hamara becha hua zehar daudega']

['Jab main tumse pehli baar mili thi, main nahi jaanti thi ki tum kaun ho ... lekin jab tumhe dekha toh aise laga jaise ... tumhara hi intezaar tha', 'Aakhri chand second hi toh haar aur jeet ka faisla karte hai', 'Jis insaan ne pehli baat jhoot se shuru ki ho ... usse kisi aur ko jhoota kehne ka koi haq nahi hai', 'Ek ek kona toh sabke paas hai ... magar ladki kisi ko bhi nahi milti', 'Ye mauka haath se mat jaane dena ... jhappi maar ke pappi le lena']

['Rajneeti ki bhains ke liye daulat ki lathi ki zaroorat hoti hai', 'Zindagi ke kisi bhi modh par, kisi bhi halaat mein ... tum mera saath nibhaogi', 'Agar tumne chalaki karne ki koshish ki, yah police ko khabar ki ... toh main tumhari beti ke chhote chhote tukde karke ... tumhe chey mahine tak installment ki soorat mein bhejta rahoonga', 'Pyar ki shuruvat hi gaaliyon se hoti hai', 'Opposition agar janta ko bhashan deti hai ... toh hum janta ko ration denge', 'Kabhi kisi se aaisa mazaak mat karna ... jisse uski duniya ujhad jaye ya uski jaan chali jaye', 'Shart ke maidan ka tu sabse bada khiladi hai', 'Kya garmi hai inke pyar mein ... undon mein se bachche nikal aaye']

['Itna mat sooch ... sooch gehri ho jaaye ... toh faisle kamzor ho jaate hai', 'Faanoos banke jiski hifaazat hawa kare ... woh shama kya bhuje jise roshan khuda kare', 'Jahil ki baaton ka jawaab ... khamoshi hota hai', 'Chaudwee ka chaand ho ya aaftab ho ... joh bhi ho tum khuda ki kasam lajawab ho', 'Chuha sher ka mooch ke baal se khelne ka himmat tabhi karta hai ... jab sher lohe ka zanjeer mein jakda hua ho', 'Waqt aur kismat badalne mein derr nahi lagti', 'Mere haath lohe ki zanjeer se nahi ... dosti ke dhaage se banda hai', 'Cheel ki chaunch mein angoor, khuda ki kudrat ... pehlu-e-hoor mein langoor, khuda ki kudrat', 'Pyar ka teer waqt ka mohtaj nahi hota', 'Sar zameen-e-Hindustan, as-salaam alaykum ... mera naam Badshah Khan hai ... ishq mera mazhab, mohabbat mera imaan ... mohabbat, jiske liye Farhad ne pahadon ka seena cheer kar dhood ka dariya baha diya ... mohabbat, jiske liye Majnu ne seharaon ki khaakh chaani ... ussi mohabbat ke liye Kabul ka yeh pathan sar zameen-e-Hindustan se mohabbat ka khair maangne aaya hai ... aazmayish kadi hai, imtihan mushkil, lekin hausla buland ... jeet hamesha mohabbat ka hua hai ... sadiyon se yehi hota aaya hai, yehi hoga ... khuda gawah hai!', 'Jin musafiron ki manzilein alag alag ho jaye ... woh saath saath nahi chala karte', 'Taqdeerein badalne ke liye ... ek lamha bhi kaafi hota hai', 'Dil ke zakhm, dawao se nahi bharte']

['Lambe lambe baal Bengal ke, sudol jism UP ka, gora rang Kashmir ka, kali kali aankhen Madras ki ... aaisa lagta hai jaisa pura Hindustan ek hi soorat mein sama gaya ho', 'Darr aur dehshat ki eenton par hi daulat ka jhanda lehraya jaata hai', 'Yeh woh shehar hai jahan sasta khoon aur mehanga pani hai ... apni pyaas bhujane ka hai toh apne aasoon se bhuja ... aasoon pee aur jee']

['Ek aurat jab tak maa nahi banti ... woh adhoori rehti hai', 'Tawaif aur titli mein koi farak nahi hota ... titli bhi ek phool par nahi tikti aur tawaif ek mard par', 'Haai gul-e-gulzar, jaan-e-bahar ... vaise kaafi ho vazandar', 'Agar sharifon ki betiyon ke liye pati ka ghar puja ka mandir hai ... toh tawaifon ki betiyon ke liye toh pati ka ghar na jaane kitne mandiron ki pujaon ka phal hai', 'Pyar ke mamle mein aur khane ke mamle mein ... doosre ki marzi mein apni marzi ki taang nahi adana chahiye']

['Naam hai ishq mera, husn ka deewana hoon ... kabhi bhanwara kabhi bulbul, kabhi parwana hoon ... mere hi dum se haseeno mein mohabbat jaagi ... naaz-o-andaz-o-adashokhi shararat jaagi ... jab haseen log mera naam liya karte hai ... dono haathon se jigar thaam liya karte hai ... phir bhi tanhai ka ehsaas liye phirta hoon ... ek dariya hoon magar pyaas liye phirta hoon', 'Main yoon hi bekhudi mein keh gaya hoon dilruba tumko ... khuda ka khauff na hota toh keh deta khuda tumko', 'Wafa ki aag hum zalim tere dil mein laga denge ... kasam teri kisi din ishq karna bhi sikha denge', 'Hum ahl-e-ishq hai, teer aur talwar se nahi darte ... nazar bhar dekh lo zalim toh khud hi mar jaayein']

['Maine aasoon bechkar daulat nahi kamai ... joh aasoon dekhkar daulat luta doon', 'Saanp apne dushman ki tasveer apni aankhon mein utaar leta hai ... Bond apne dushmanon ka nishaan apne baazu saja leta hai ... apna apna style hai', 'Shyam hote hi tanhaiyan mujhe til-til maarne lagti hai ... aaise mein agar koi saathi saath na ho, toh aasoon bhi gale mil-mil behne lagte hai', 'Kaali billi bhi agar mera rasta kaat jaye toh mujhe kuch nahi hoga ... balki woh mar jayegi', 'Jab kuch karne aur na karne dono mein hi risk ho ... toh kuch karna hi achcha hota hai', 'Ek maa ki fariyad jab woh dil cheerkar, aasunyon se nahakar nikalti hai ... toh joh cheez aag aur tezaab se jalti ... usse jala deti hai', 'Tumne mere bhai ke jism se jitne khoon ke katre bahaye hai ... main tumhare jism ko cheerkar utne hi hisson mein baant doonga', 'Khoobsurat ladkiyan aur machliyan ek jaisi nahi hoti ... unhe pakadne ke liye kuch aaisi chaalein chalni padti hai, jisse woh pakad mein aa jaye ... aur agar woh na aaye toh khud unke paas jaana padta hai']

['Peetal par sone ka pani chadene se ... peetal sona nahi ban jaata', 'Jaako raakhe saaiya maar sake na koi ... aur jaako maare saaiya usse bacha sake na koi', 'Main sirf teri jaan lena nahi chahta ... main yeh chahta hoon ki tu tadap tadapkar mare ... guzarne waala har pal tujhse kahe ki yamdoot tere peeche peeche aa rahe hai']

['Band karo yeh yudh ... is yudh ki jeet mein bhi haar hai aur haar mein bhi haar hai', 'Parampara ko na koi talwar kaat sakti hai, na koi aag jala sakti aur na waqt badal sakta hai', 'Dosti do tareekon se hoti hai ... ya toh bachpan mein saath khelen ho ... ya sirf pehli mulaqat mein', 'Jab main aankhen bandh karti hoon aapki tasveer mere samne aati hai ... jab main saans leti hoon aapki khushboo aati hai ... jab main soo jaati hoon aap mere sapno mein aa jaate hai']

['Amir aadmi kabhi kabhi itna gareeb hota hai ... ki uske paas paise ke sivah aur kuch nahi hota hai', 'Main samajhti thi ki shaadi do insaano mein hoti hai ... lekin tumhare pitaji se pata chala ki shaadi ek insaan ki doosre insaan ke saath nahi ... ek bank balance ki doosre bank balance ke saath, ek haisiyat ki doosre haisiyat ke saath, ek rutbe ki doosre rutbe ke saath hoti hai', 'Ladki jab ek baar suhag ka joda pehenle aur uski shaadi na ho ... toh wohi joda uske liye kafan ban jaata hai', 'Dard ka ehsaas jinhe hota hai ro sakte hai ... gair ke ashq bhi daaman ko bhigo sakte hai ... neend aati nahi phoolon pe akalmandon ko ... prem deewane toh kaanton pe bhi soo sakte hai', 'Main woh keeda hoon joh ek baar jism se lag jaye ... toh poora khoon choosne ke baad hi chhodta hai']

['Mann ke haare haar hai ... aur mann ke jeete jeet', 'Isse main hazar tarah se, hazar baar, hazar maut maaroonga', 'Jab koi bulbul qaid ho jaati hai ... toh uski tadap usse aur bhi khoobsurat bana deti hai']
['Ishq jab ek taraf hoye toh sazaa deta hai ... aur jab dono taraf hoye toh mazaa deta hai', 'Is paar nahi toh phir, us paar milenge hum ... sau baar bichadke bhi, ek baar milenge hum']

['Degree se sirf certificate milta hai ... akal nahi', 'Assi tussi piyange lassi', 'Saatve asmaan ko choone ki koshish karte karte ... yeh main pataal mein pahunch gaya hoon', 'Phatte huye joote ke chedh se us paar dekhoge na, haqeeqat nazar aayegi ... joota bada duniya choti nazar aayegi ... kismat phatke haath mein aa jayegi', 'Shukriya toh gairon ka ada kiya jaata hai ... apno ka nahi', 'Agar main chota kaam karoonga na ... toh chota hi ban kar reh jaonga', 'Sunday ke baad monday, rupaye ke char ande ... khaye kisi aur ne dande, ab raj kar rahe hai mushtande', 'Is Bambai shehar mein jhagda karne se sar phoote na phoote ... lekin mohabbat karne se dil tootne ka guarantee', 'Sachai aur imaandari ki buniyaad par jhoot aur fareb ka mahal bahut dino tak nahi tik sakta ... woh gir jaata hai', 'Aaise naukri kaise milegi bhai ... is ulti duniya ko sar ke bal khade hokar dekhoge toh seedhi nazar aayegi ... apni arzi par wazan nahi rakha, hawa mein udh jayegi', 'Sadak pe tamasha karne waala aur dekhne waala ... dono ka taqdeer kharab hai', 'Yeh duniya banane waala apni hi duniya mein aakar besahara ho gaya ... tu kis khet ki mooli hai?', 'Hindu ko namaskar nahi bolega, Musalman ko salaam nahi karega, Christian ko good morning nahi bolega ... kyun ki apan yahan language ka lafda karne nahi aiyla']

['Yahan tourist guide, jyotish wala, ayurved wala, allopathy, homeopathy, Sitapati, Ganpati, Laxmipati sara main hi hoon ... all in all main hi hoon', 'Pehle yahan dher saare tourist aaya karte the ... ab terrorist hi aate hai', 'Main bura toh hoon par bahut nahi ... thoda acha bhi hoon']

['Duniya ke raste bade kathin hote hai ... lekin tum nirash na hona, himmat na harna ... koshisho ke pedho par hi kamyaabi ke phal lagte hai', 'Apna toh style hi yehi hai ... bandook bhi apni, taqat bhi apni, aur nishana bhi apna', 'Sachai kehne wale ki zubaan lambi nahi hoti hai ... tezz hoti hai ... kyun ki iski haqeeqat dil par teer ki tarah chub jaati hai']

['Maa ki mamta aulad ki zindagi ke liye amrit hai ... lekin jab woh mamta andhi ho jaye toh zehar ban jaati hai', 'Jab mujhpar koi haath uthata hai toh mera sar phir jaata hai ... aur jab mera sar phir jaata hai toh main saamne waale ki duniya phira deta hoon', 'Jawaani ki pasand ko tajurba aur dil ki pasand ko dimaag agar tol le ... toh thokar nahi lagti']

['Hum jurm ki duniya ka colonel hoon', 'Bazaar mein behti tawaif aur aapke kanoon ke rakhwaalon mein koi fark nahi hai ... fark hai toh sirf itna, ki woh apna jism bechti hai aur yeh apna imaan', 'Aadmi naujawan ho yah meri tarah tajurbekar ... raat ko aurat se jhagde mein kabhi nahi jeet sakta', 'Yahan Punjabi hai, Gujarati hai, Marathi hai, Bangali hai ... lekin Hindustani koi nahi hai', 'Bura joh kaam karta hai woh manzil se bhatakta hai ... kamina lakh baande boriyan, magar ek din atakta hai', 'Meri toh na usse Hello hai na Hi hai ... na jaan hai na pehchaan hai ... na dua hai na salaam hai', 'Mere mooh se nikla har lafz ... heere se zyada keemti hai', 'Har jagah mera hi number pehle aata hai']

['Agar tere paas nafrat ki taqat hai ... toh mere paas ab mohabbat ki shakti hai', 'Mangalsutra zaroor gale mein pehna jaata hai ... magar iska rishta saanson se juda hota hai', 'Dhere dhere, chaba chabake, thanda karke khana chahiye ... yahi buzurgon ka kehna hai, isko na thukrana chahiye']

['Maana ki kismat ne hara diya hai dost, par itne toh gunehgar nahi hum ... mare ek sipahi ki maut, kya iske bhi haqdar nahi hum', 'Bechkar imaan kamai daulat toh insaan kya ... namak khaya jis watan ka, ussi ka na hua toh Musalman kya', 'Dong kabhi wrong nahi hota!', 'Jisne dil pe zakhm khaye ho, woh is zakhm se kya gabrayega ... peeye ho jisne khoon ke aasoon, kya woh is khoon se mar jayega', 'Badalne waali hum cheez nahi ... arre hum mard hai, koi kameez nahi', 'Apne matlab ke vaaste humne aasmano se kuch nahi maanga ... humne gulshan ki khair maangi hai koi takht-o-taj nahi maanga', 'Jab jab koi Dong jaisa kamina apne napaak irradon ke liye ... aatankwad ki talwar lekar Hindustan mein tahalka machayega ... toh Hindustani sipahi bhi uske mulk mein jakar ... uske tahalke ka jawab ussi tahalke se denge']

['Apna toh ussool hai ... pehle laat, phir baat, uske baad mulaqat', 'Hum kisi se bhi, kisi waqt bhi, kahin bhi mil sakte hain ... hamara jab dil chahe', 'Hum tumhe woh maut denge ... joh na to kisi kanoon ki kitaab mein likhi hogi ... aur na hi kabhi kisi mujrim ne soochi hogi', 'Hamari zabaan bhi hamari goli ki tarah ... dushmanon se seedhe baat karti hai', 'Hum aankhon se soorma nahin churate ... hum aankhen hi chura lete hain', 'Na talwaar ki dhaar se, na goliyon ki bauchaar se ... banda darta hai toh, sirf parvar digaar se', 'Yeh toh laal mirch hai teekhi teekhi ... haath lagao toh haath jale ... mooh lagao toh mooh jale ... dil lagao toh dil jale', 'Yeh commando bada khatarnaak hai ... tumhara baap hai', 'Maratha marta hai yah maarta hai', 'Joh bhaari nah ho ... woh dushmani hi kya', 'Apna toh ussool hai ... pehle mulaqat, phir baat, aur phir agar zaroorat pare toh laat', 'Tujhe aaisi maut maroonga ... ki teri paapi atma agle saat janam tak, kisi doosre shareer mein ghusne ke pehle kaanp uthegi', 'Kaunsa kanoon, kaisa kanoon ... yeh kanoon toh chand mujrimon ki rakhail ban behta hai', 'Pandra sau ki naukri karne waala ... ek din tujhe dedh sau ka kafan pehnayega', 'Sache police ki ya toh maut hoti hai ... ya toh suspend kiya jaata hai', 'Yeh Delhi bas mooh hai is liye batar-batar karti rehti hai ... yeh karna hai, yeh hona chahiye, hum mein dikhana hai ... bas dil ko tasalli dene ke liye achcha lafz hai Delhi']

['Kaante sirf zakhm de sakte hai ... khushboo nahi de sakte', 'Abhi aaye, abhi behte, abhi daaman sambhala hai ... tumhari aulad bhi kya yaad karegi, ki chacha ne kya dum nikala hai', 'Ladkon se agar ladna hai toh ladakpan mein aana hi padega ... pachpan se nikalkar bachpan mein aana hi padega']

['Rakhail aurat ki koi jaat nahi hoti ... aur na hi koi aurat kisi jayaz ya najayaz aulad ki maa kehlati hai ... woh toh sirf maa hoti hai', 'Dhuan, dhuan aur dhuan ... chala hai dil, chala hai jahaan ... is jalti duniya ko chhodkar jaon kahan', 'Banaya hai jisne tumko dekho usse kaise hum banate hai ... maa banane se pehle bhabhi usse hum banate hai']

['Meri shaadi ho chuki hai, magar maut se', 'Tumhare aur maut ke beech ... meri pistol se nikli sirf ek goli ka faasla reh gaya hai', 'Ajgar kisse, kab aur kahan nighal jaata hai ... yeh toh marne waale ko bhi pata nahin chalta', 'Main sarkari afsar hoon ... farz mera dharm hai', 'Arre yeh lo ... aa gaye kalyug ke kanhaiya', 'Vishwa mein unhi atmaon ko puja jaata hai ... joh shanti ke marg par chalte hai', 'Jab bhi hum koi khel khelte hai ... toh saare mohron ko apni ungliyon par nachate hai', 'Aaj hoga mere aakhri dushman ka khaatma ... aur phir kehlaunga main is duniya ka vishwatma', 'Ajgar apne shikaar ko das kar nahi maarta ... balki usse apne lapet mein jakadkar uski haddiyon ke tukde tukde kar deta hai ... aur uski saanson ka gubaar nikal deta hai', 'Ek kaayar bete ka pita kehlane se kahi behtar hai ... ki ek bahadur shaheed ka baap kehlaon', 'Thappad tumhare mooh par pada hai ... aur nishaan mere gaal par chhape hai']

['Agar tumhari maut mera sivah kisi aur ke haath hui ... toh mujhe behad afsoos hoga', 'Sirf paise ke liye jaan ka sauda toh chor, daku, smuggler aur badmash bhi karte hai ... lekin ek jhande ke liye jaan ka sauda sirf ek sipahi karta hai', 'Syahi sasti hai, khoon mehenga hai ... ek mamuli si tankha par apni syahi baha dena koi mushkil kaam nahi ... lekin ek mamuli si tankha par apna khoon baha dena sirf dilari hi nahi ... deewangi hai', 'Ek baar marna hamesha aasaan hota hai ... lekin woh kambakht cheez jisse zindagi kehte hai ... uske liye kadam kadam pe marna padta hai', 'Jis bhagwan ko tu maanta hai ... uske saamne aaj aakhri baar apne haath uthakar dua maangle ... kyun ki aaj ke baad tere haath kabhi nahin uthenge', 'Meri raftaar meri zindagi hai', 'Main janta hoon ki tumhare haath bahut lambe hai, bahut upar tak jaate hai ... lekin khaki ke samne khadi ki taqat dikhane ki koshish mat karo ... kyun ki main yeh khaki utarkar khadi pehan sakta hoon ... lekin tumhare neta khadi utarkar khaki nahi pehen sakte', 'Hamare liye ek murda police officer, ek zinda police officer se zyada kaam ka hota hai', 'Hum jaise log maut ke saath shatranj ka khel khelte hain ... kabhi baazi uski, kabhi baazi hamari', 'Doosre janam mein yakeen ho ... toh maut ka khauf kam ho jaata hai']

['Hamara yeh pesha shatranj ki bisat se kam nahi ... chote se chote mohre ko maarne ke liye hum mein dekhna padta hai ... ki uska vazir kaun hai, badshah kaun hai', 'Gussa insaan ka sabse bada dushman hai ... jisse gusse par kabu nahi, woh kisi cheez par kabu nahi rakh sakta ... gussa insaan ki akal ko kha jaata hai', 'Kabhi kabhi kahin ruk jana hi achcha hota hai ... varna manzil peeche reh jaati hai aur insaan aage nikal jaata hai', 'Prem ki sabse badi kushalta yeh hai ... ki is mein lene waala bhi kuch deta hai aur dene waala bhi kuch paata hai', 'Aaj main apni hukumat ki adaalat ka gawah bankar, vakil bankar, judge bankar ... tum jaise khoon ka sauda karne waale saudagar ko sazaa deta hoon ... sazaaye maut', 'Main us haramzade ko aaisi bhayanak maut doonga ... ki kaali duniya ka har mujrim gaddari ke naam se kaanp uthega']

['Judai ka gham jitna hoga ... milan ka mazaa utna hi zyada hoga', 'Daulat mein hi woh taqat hai joh har sapna, har umeed, har umang ko haqeeqat mein dhaal sake', 'Khoobsurati ki tareef toh dekhte hi ki jani chahiye ... chahe woh koi ladki ho ya koi haseen phool', 'Daulat se kai zyada ooncha darja us insaan ka hota hai ... jiske usool aur adarsh oonche ho ... aur jinhe banaye rakhne ke khatir woh badi se badi qurbani de sakta hai', 'Mauke diye nahi, liye jaate hai ... jahan bhi mil jaye', 'Josh mein mat aao varna hosh kho baithoge']

['Main fauladi shaitan ki madad se sultan toh kya ... sari duniya par fateh hasil kar sakta hoon ... shaitan zindabad, shaitan zindabad', 'Jako rakhe saiyan, maar sake na koi ... baal na baka kar sake, joh jag bairi hoye', 'Sukh aur dukh dono uparwaale ki den hai ... is liye sukh ki tarah dukh ko bhi apnana seekho', 'Husn ka deewana hoon ... kabhi bhawara, kabhi bulbul, kabhi parwana hoon', 'Tum angoor ke woh guchhe ho jinse sharab nichodi ja chuki hai ... aur Ruksana ek paka hua anaar hai jiska ek ek dana hum choos choos kar khayenge', 'Uparwaala kisi ko sazaa dene ke liye khud chalkar neeche nahi aata ... ussike kehane se koi insaan zulm aur sitam ka muqabla karne ke liye uthta hai ... aur aaj main zulm ko khatam karke hi rahoonga', 'Hamare Hind mein auraton ko izzat ki nazaron se dekha jaata hai ... hawas aur besharmi se nahi', 'Aainda kisi gareeb par haath uthane ki koshish ki ... toh tumhare haathon ko bhik mangne ke kabil bhi nahi chhodunga', 'Apne zulm ki takat par itna naaj na karna ... kyun ki tumhari napak hasti ko nestonabud karne waala paida ho chuka hai', 'Mamta ki koi zaban nahi hoti ... naa hi pyar ki koi tasveer hoti hai', 'Husn ibaadat hai meri, ishq mazhab hai mera ... hoon toh insaan magar, bhes hai parwane ka', 'Isse toh aaise zakhm do joh kabhi na bhare ... aur yeh zindagi bhar apni hi laash ko apne kandhon par uthaye tadpata rahe', 'Main Hind ki sherni hoon ... mera ek panja uth gaya toh tera ye haath tere dhad se alag ho jayega']

['Jinke paas zabaan nahi hoti ... woh aksar aasoonyon se baatein karne lagte hai', 'Kehte hai patni ke liye pati parmeshwar hote hai ... mere liye toh lagta hai parmeshwar hi pati banne aa gaye', 'Phir kabhi tune mere ghar ke andhar jhanke ki koshish ki ... toh main apne darwaze par limbu mirchi ki jagah ... teri mundi kaatkar latka doonga', 'Aurat ki izzat par agar ek baar daag lag jaye ... toh woh kabhi nahi dhul sakta hai', 'Tumhe mere pyar par gussa aa raha hai ... magar mujhe tumhare gusse par pyar aa raha hai']

['Main toh film bhi dekhkar pasand karti hoon, story sunkar nahi ... ussi tarah main ladka bhi dekhkar pasand ya napasand karoongi', 'Hum toh kalakar hai ... hamari kala ki taqdeer mein car likhi hi nahi hai ... yeh kalakar bekaar sadakon par dhukaar ki tarah ghoom raha hai, dhukaar ki tarah', 'Jab kaam ka bhoj badh jaata hai na ... toh dimaag ki wiring mein short circuit ho jaati hai', 'Ek ek do do peg toh do do takke ke log peete hai ... hum toh poori botal peene waalon mein se hai', 'Aatma ek magar naam do, Kishen Kanhaiya ... ab dekhna main kaise bajata hoon inka band bhaiya', 'Main toh aakhi zindagi samajhdari ki baat karte rehta hoon ... magar afsoos ki baat yeh hai ki pehli martaba meri samajhdari ki baat aapki samajhdari ki pitaari mein utari hai ... samajhe ki nahi?']

['Is shehar par aaisa qahar bankar gir ... ki insaan toh kya ... is shehar ka zara zara us qahar se kaanp uthte, gabrakar chilla uthte', 'Tum log itna itna sa the talaab mein nange nahate the ... hum pakadkar bahar nikaalte the ... ab toh tum poore James Bond ho gaye ... saand ke saand ho gaye', 'Kroadh woh zehareela saanp hai joh dasta zaroor kisi doosre ko hai ... lekin zehar khud ki zindagi mein ghol deta hai', 'Goonjte hai tere nagamon se ameeron ke mahal ... jhopdiyon mein bhi teri awaaz hai ... apne sangeet pe toh sabhi ko naaz hai', 'Yeh jhoot hai judge sahab, sarasar jhoot hai ... meri statement har lafz utna hi sacha hai jitna Mahabharat aur Ramayan mein likha har lafz ... meri statement utni hi sachi aur paakh hai jitni ki meri jism par yeh vardi', 'Gaon mein hafte mein log bazaar lene aate hai ... yahan bazaar mein hafta lene aate hai', 'Yeh kroadh joh har waqt naak par laga rehta hai na ... yahi kroadh ek din naak katvakar rakh deta hai']

['Pati toh sabhi ko mil sakta hai ... lekin achcha insaan kisi kisiko milta hai', 'Waqt aur taqdeer se jeetna bahut mushkil hota hai', 'Agar kisi stree ko apne purush ka mann jeetna ho toh uske liye do hi raste hai ... ek khane ka aur doosra sone ka', 'Agar kisi ko jaan se maar dena kanoonan jurm hai ... toh kisi ke charitra ki hatya karna bhi ek sangeen jurm se kam nahi', 'Nau mahine pet mein rakhne se koi aurat maa nahi ban jaati ... kya tumne ek maa ki tarah kabhi isse apna doodh pilaya, kabhi apni baahon mein jhulaya, kabhi seene se lagakar pyar kiya ... nahi ... jab tumne maa ka kartavya nahi nibhaya toh tum mein maa kehlane ka koi adhikar nahi', 'Jidhar shaq ghus jaata hai na ... khushi udhar se alvida bolke chali jaati hai', 'Kisi ka ehsaan bhi tabhi lena chahiye ... jab usse utaarne ki khud mein taqat ho']

['Jab aulad ki zindagi ka sawaal ho ... toh maa din aur raat nahi dekhti', 'Ek patni apni pati ke liye apne armaano ka khoon toh kar sakti hai ... lekin ek maa apni aulad ki khushi ke liye sari duniya se takra sakti hai', 'Ek baap das bachche paida kar sakta hai ... lekin das bachche milkar ek baap nahi bana sakte', 'Naye jooton ki tarah shuru mein naye naye afsar bhi kaatte hai', 'Muqaddar ke badshah ke liye kuch bhi namumkin nahi hai', 'Upar waale ne yeh dil patthar ka banaya hai ... isse shock toh lag sakta hai, lekin kabhi stop nahi ho sakta', 'Joh rishta swarth ke dhaago se bandha ho ... uske toot jaane mein koi harj nahi']

['Dharti par itna anyay karne ke baad bhi ... insaan ko jeene ke liye, palne ke liye, yahan tak ki marne ke liye bhi dharti ko gaud chahiye ... yahi dharti ki jeet hai', 'Chup chaap anyay sehna kamzori hai ... magar anyay karne waale ko chetavani dekar muqabale ki ghoshana karke ... mann ki dhirdta se, magar ahinsa se uske anyay ka anth dekhna kamzori nahi, shakti hai', 'Atmavishvas se insaan ko hi nahi ... bhagwan ko bhi jeeta ja sakta hai']

['Toofan mein hum apni khushi chahte hai ... jaan hatheli pe liye jee jaate hai ... tum woh joh samundar jinhe kha jaata hai ... hum woh joh samundar ko pee jaate hai', 'Sher ki khaal pehenkar aaj tak koi aadmi sher nahin ban saka', 'Aurat toh narm matti ki bani hoti hai ... kabhi bhi toot sakti hai', 'Bahut log is rupaiye ke peeche bhaagte hai ... lekin chand aaise hote hai jinke peeche rupaiya bhaagta hai', 'Chalaaki karne waala khud hi apni chalaaki ka shikaar ho jata hai', 'Dil ki awaaz dil se suni jaati hai', 'Kauva oonchai par bahetne se kabootar nahi ban jata', 'Humne dekhe hai bahut baatein banane waale ... baatein waale toh janaab kaam kidhar karte hai ... woh joh dekhe hi nahi toofan uthate sagar ... woh kya khaak samundar mein safar karte hai', 'Rishwat khao aur rishwat khilao', 'Insaaf ke jin saudargaro ke bhram par, tum farz ka sauda kar rahe ho ... unki gardane bhi hamare haatho se door nahi', 'Hamari aadatein bhi toh harami hai']

['Doosron ki seva karna hi bhagwan ki puja karna hai', 'Toofan kabhi kabhi apne saath sailaab lata hai ... aur sailaab se uthe hue bhanwar bahut khatarnak ho sakte hai', 'Joh meri asliyat pehchaane ki koshish karega ... main uski asliyat puri bighaad doonga']

['Ek gareeb ki sabse badi daulat uski izzat hai ... aur woh izzat dekar bhi apna pyar, apne sapne kabhi nahi khareed sakta', 'Har daulat ke peeche koi na koi jurm hota hai ... aur jab tak jurm nahi karta na koi lakhpati banta hai, na crorepati', 'Gareebon ka khoon jab saanche mein dhalta hai toh yeh sikka banta hai ... aur jab yeh sikka bazar mein tulta hai ... toh kisi gareeb ke bhai ko kitaabein milti hai, college milta hai ... aane waale sunhere kal ki umeedein milti hai', 'Main akela hi chala tha apni manzil ki taraf ... log saath aate gaye aur karavan banta gaya ... khoon-e-dil se humne likhi gham ki yoon dastan ... zindagi ka shandar ek gulsitan banta gaya', 'Mohabbat ho ya jung ... do hi cheezein jeeta sakti hai ... ek rokda aur doosra danda', 'Sona ho ya chandi, usse tolne ka tarazu lohe ya peetal hi ka hota hai ... is hi tarah duniya ki har cheez insaaniyat ke tarazu pe toli jaati hai', 'Daulat ki mandi mein kanoon hamare isharon par kathputli ki tarah naachta hai ... aur insaaf hum karte hai, hum', 'Agar ab bhi tumhe gareeb ki taqat ka andaaza nahi toh jao ... duniya mein jitne mahal bane hai ... unki khandaron ki ek ek eent se poocho ki tumhe banane waala kaun aur mitaane waala kaun', 'Mere maula kab talak gussa na unpar aayega ... zaalimon pe rehman aakhir kab talak farmayega ... kab talak hote rahenge bekason pe zulm aur sitam ... kab talak yeh khooni manzar bas tu dekhe jayega', 'Iski laash ke itne tukde banenge ... ki rone waala yeh bhi samajh nahi payega ki kis tukde ko pakadkar roye', 'Yeh woh danda hai joh badan pe pade toh chamdi phatti nahi hai ... dard haddiyon tak ghus jaata hai', 'Zulm phir zulm hai ... badta hai toh mitt jaata hai ... khoon phir khoon hai ... tapakta hai toh jam jaata hai']

['Yeh maa ki gaud nahin hai ... maut ki gaud hai', 'Mere chehre pe kutte ki naak lagi hui hai ... main apne karazdaar ko soongh ke pakad leta hoon', 'Shobhraj joh karta hai woh kehta nahi ... pehle karta hai phir kehta hai']

['Maut aur badnaseebi do hi aisi cheezein hai ... joh bagair khabar kiye aate hai', 'Joh pehli saans lene ki choot deta hai ... wohi aakhri saans par rok laga sakta hai', 'Maut sabse halki sazaa hoti hai', 'Insaano mein kuch log zehreelay saanpo se bhi zyada khatarnak hote hai ... aur kuch log devtaon se bhi zyada mann ke sachche aur achche', 'Sansar ka yeh niyam hai ke paapi kabhi amar nahi hote', 'Joh baap apni beti ko apne faide ke liye istemaal karte hai ... usse kothi mein nahi, kothe pe rehna chahiye', 'Dil mein gandagi lekar paida hone waala insaan ... kabhi amar nahi ho sakta', 'Ek patni ke liye vidhva bankar jeene se toh achcha hai ... ki woh suhaagan ki maut mare', 'Chinta aur chitta mein sirf ek bindu ka farak hai', 'Pyar ek aisi cheez hai ... aadmi toh aadmi, janwar bhi dost ban jaata hai', 'Har aadmi insaan nahin hota', 'Mangalsutra ek aisi cheez hai jiski keemat ek suhagan hi bata sakti hai', 'Saanp ka zeher sirf uske daanton mein hi nahi ... balke uski phook mein bhi hota hai', 'Baap ke saath beti ki har vachan shaadi ke mandap mein jal kar raakh ho jaata hai ... aur pati ko diya hua vachan shareer ki raakh ho jaane ke baad bhi nibhana padta hai']

['Duniya mein gareeb pehda hona koi jurm nahi, koi paap nahi ... magar gareeb marna sabse bada jurm hai, sabse bada paap hai', 'Bhagwan toh hamesha bhagwan hi rehta hai ... uski har haal mein puja ki jati hai ... chahe woh apne bhakt ko sukh de yah dukh', 'Jab tak swarg mein devta nahi hota ... swarg, swarg nahi hota hai', 'Duniya ka koi insaan bura aadmi nahi hota ... koi aadmi apni maa ke pet se bura pehda nahi hota ... koi chor apni khushi se chori nahi karta ... koi daaku apni khushi se daaka nahi dalta ... koi tawaif apni khushi se apna jism nahi bechti ... waqt aur halaat insaan ko bura banne pe majboor kar dete hai', 'Gareeb ki kismat us par kuch dino ke liye meherbaan toh ho sakti hai ... magar hamesha ke liye savar nahi sakti', 'Yeh kursi bhi bewafaa mehbooba ki tarah hai ... aaj iski toh kal uski', 'Dushmani karo toh dushman ko raaste ka bhikhari bana do ... taaki woh haath failaye, haath utha na sake', 'Ek door ka chacha hai aur ek mooh boli bhabhi ... door ka chacha mujhse door hi rehta hai ... aur mooh boli bhabhi kabhi mujhe mooh nahi lagati', 'Bahadur ko uski bahaduri fasati hai ... aur darpok ko uska dar', 'Saanp aur imaandar aadmi dono ek saath mil jaye ... toh pehle imaandar aadmi ko maar daalo', 'Uparwaale ki lathi mein awaaz nahi hoti', 'Gareeb ka gareeb se toh woh rishta hota hai ... joh bhai ka bhai se nahi hota ... bete ka baap se nahi hota', 'Khana hai toh chaata bhi kha lo ... magar byaj ke saath vapas karo', 'Agar rishwat lete huve pakde jao ... toh rishwat dekar choot jao', 'Der se uthna sehat ke liye buri baat hoti hai', 'Kahi apne begaane ho jaate hai ... aur kahi begaane apne ho jaate hai']

['Jurm ki duniya ke chote bhai ... hum kanoon ki duniya ke bade bhai hain', 'Aainda khayal rakhna ki josh mein zabaan na ladkhadaye ... warna apne hosh kho baithoge', 'Yeh dosti ka haath maut ka panja tab banta hai ... jab hum dushmani pe utar aate hai', 'Tujhse ghayal hone mein toh bahut mazaa aayega', 'Ab yeh haath chori ke maal ka bhoj nahin ... balki hathkari ka bhoj uthayenge', 'Ek shaheed ki patni kabhi vidhva nahi hoti ... sada suhagan rehti hai', 'Agar Lawrence aur Peter ko gussa aa gaya ... toh tumhara zindagi maut se baatein karne lagega', 'Jabse huyi hai shaadi, aasoon baha raha hoon ... aafat gale padi hai, usko nibha raha hoon', 'Khoobsurat premika ... patni ka roop dharan karte hi kitni badsurat ban jati hai', 'Joh bhi Thakur ko intezaar karne ko kehta hai ... woh uski zindagi ki ghadi bandh kar deta hai', 'Zameen kisaan ki maa hoti hai']

['Jab bete ki ghar mein shikayatein aane lage aur gaon mein charcha hone lage ... toh samjho beta jawan ho gaya', 'Meri nazar padne se pehle isse itni door le jana ... ki hawa bhi iska pata mujh tak na pahuncha sake']

['Main tujhe aaisi maut maroonga ... ki marne ke baad tera bejaan jism mere naam se kaanpega', 'Mera baap ne mera naam Gulanand aaisi hi nahi rakha ... joh log mere saath anand se pesh aate hai ... unhe main gulab ki khushboo deta hoon ... aur joh log mere saath khroad se pesh aate hai ... unhe main gulab ke kaanton ki tarah chubne par majboor ho jaata hoon', 'Mohabbat ek aaisa amrit hota hai ... ki jiski ek boond bhi agar tumhare jism mein utar jaye ... toh yeh duniya tumhe sabse zyada khoobsurat nazar aayegi', 'Jab tak is jag mein paap ka raj hai ... tab tak Jagraj hai', 'Aurat ke husn ka nishana kabhi khali nahi jaata', 'Mere kanne chakku hai!']

['Jab dost ke irrade pakke ... toh dushman ke chutte chakke', 'Mukka-laat ke baad joh mulaqat hoti hai ... badi pakki hoti hai', 'Joh hamara taraf aankh uthayega, hum uska aankh phod dalega ... joh saala awaaz uthayega, hum uska zubaan kaat dalega ... aur joh sar uthayega, uska sar todh dega', 'Jab tarazu mein paise ka palhada halka ho jaata hai ... tab maut ka palhada bhari ho jaata hai']
['Vidhaata ki laathi beawaaz hoti hai', 'Chote teer ghaav gambhir ... bahut chubte hai', 'Aai aai yo aaiyo ... aai aai aai yooo!', 'Kitni door pahunch gaye sir!']

['Ek police officer duty par mahez ek police officer hota hai ... wahan na koi behen hoti hai, na bhai hota hai ... wahan na koi rishta hi hota hai aur na hi koi naata', 'Jitni badi kranti lani hoti hai ... utni hi badi shanti ki zaroorat hoti hai', 'Yeh chandi ke sapne aur sone ki saansein lete the ... lekin inhe nahi malum tha ... ki chandi ke sapne pranon par zanjeer ban jaate hai ... aur sone ki saansein atma mein zehar gholne lagti hai', 'Jal se shareer ka snaan hota hai aur aasoon se atma ka', 'Jab chacha Shaadilal par chhod di hai baat ... toh koi na koi rishta zaroor aayega haath', 'Jiske tann mein Isa, mann mein Allah aur atma mein Om basa hai ... uska duniya ki koi bhi taqat baal bhi bhaka kar sakti hai kya', 'Dahej ke laalchi kutton ke dil mein aaisi dehshat pehda kar denge ... ki dahej lena toh kya ... dahej ka naam sunte hi kaanp uthenge', 'Vishwasghaat toh woh paap hai ... jisse bhagwan bhi maaf nahi karta', 'Ek aur ek do nahi ... gyarah hote hai']

['Joh sar par kafan bandkar nikalte hai ... woh anjaam nahi sochte', 'Pyar aur dushmani mein ek hi kadam ka faasla hove hai', 'Dost marte hai, dosti nahi marti', 'Goli ka jawab goli se denge aur loot ka jawab loot se', 'Yeh maut ka shehar hai ... is shehar ki galiyon mein andhera hi andhera hai']

['Bhagwan ne aapko daulat toh zaroorat se zyada di hai ... magar dil dene mein thodi si kanjhoosi kar gaya', 'Yeh baatein bekaar ki nahin ... intezaar ki hain, ikraar ki hain, methe methe pyar ki hain', 'Daulat aapke is ghar ke nizaam ko zaroor badal sakti hai ... lekin vidhi ke vidhan ko nahi badal sakti', 'Sone chandi ke bartano mein khana khane waala amir nahi hota hai ... aircondition caron mein ghoomne waala amir nahi hota hai ... aaise sangemarmar ke bunglay mein rehne waala amir nahi hota hai ... besaharon ko sahara dena waala amir hota hai ... rote hue ko hasane waala amir hota hai ... marne waala nahin, bachane waala amir hota hai', 'Tumhe insaanon se nahin ... paison se pyar hai', 'Insaan apne vyavhaar, apne charitra, apni zubaan aur apne dil se amir hota hai', 'Kaale brahman pe haath uthake ... tune shani ki mahadasha ko bulaya hai', 'Yeh unnees reel ki film hai ... aage aage dekho hota hai kya', 'Inki zindagi ke lifaafe par ... upar jaane ka tickut toh lagai dena', 'Raat toh gayi, magar baat nahin gayi', 'Bhaag kar kahan jaaogi? ... darwaza dono taraf se bandh hai', 'Tere gande shareer se ... teri paapi aatma ko mukt kar doonga', 'Insaan ko insaan ka hi kaam karna chahiye ... bhagwan ka nahi', 'Aaj ke baad main tujhe kahin bhi, kabhi bhi, kissi bhi waqt maar daloonga']

['Mein ek nanha sa, pyara sa, chota sa bachcha hoon', 'Main aaya hoon yahan par tere liye ... aur tu banayi gayi hai mere liye', 'Tujhe toh main all India star bankar dikhaongi', 'Main madira nahi peeti ji', 'Aaj Sunday hai, toh daru peene ka din hai']

['Dard ki dawa na ho ... toh dard ko hi dawa samajh lena chahiye', 'Raaton ko jaagna meri kismat ban chuki hai', 'Jab tum mujhe apna kehte ho ... apne pe guroor aa jaata hai', 'Pyar hawa ka ek jhonka hai ... joh sab udakar le jaata hai', 'Jeevan ke kis modh pe, kab koi mil jaaye ... kaun keh sakta hai?', 'Hum Delhi waale mulk ke saath saath ... dil pe bhi hukumat karna jaante hai']

['Bambai ki ladki aur Bambai ki barish ... kabhi bhi aayegi, kabhi bhi jayegi', 'Jab tak chance rahega baki ... main nahi bandwaonga rakhi', 'Pajame ne kaha dhoti se ... bane hum dono ek dhaage se ... farak agar hai hum mein toh sirf itna ... tu khulti peeche se, main aage se', 'Bijnor mein gunda pakda gaya ... hairan hoon is daur mein gunda pakda gaya']

['Pati patni ki narazgi garmiyon ki barsaat ki tarah hoti hai ... joh hamesha nahi rehti', 'Lagta hai tum aasman se tapki ho ... upar se neeche aakar zameen par chamki ho ... uparwaale ne kya super kaam kiya hai ... tujhe fursat mein bana diya hai', 'Inteqam ka josh farz aur sachai ka sar kabhi nahi jhuka sakta', 'Aurat zindagi leti nahi ... zindagi deti hai']

['Naag hoon main naag ... kaala naag', 'Mere aadmi daulat khaate hai, daulat peete hai, daulat jeete hai, daulat soote hai', 'Marr jayenge, mitt jayenge par bhai ka sar na katenge ... desh hai humko pyara apna, hum desh mein maut na batenge', 'Markar bhi ho zaban pe Hindustan hamara, markar bhi haathon mein ho Hindustan ka nara ... agar aaisi maut mile humko, toh marna roz gavaran ... phir tu ab maare yah kal maare, hai marna humko pyara', 'Jis din yeh khel shuru hoga na ... us din gend tum hoge ... aur chakke main maroonga', 'Taaliyan bajane se kaam nahi hoga ... kaam karne se kaam hoga', 'Abhi tak bahut se police afsaron ki ragon mein ... angrezon ki pilai hui sharaab ki booh baki hai', 'Hamare desh ki mitti apne beto ko sirf ek hi baat sikhati hai ... maa ki puja, maa ki seva, maa ki raksha', 'Uss vaishi darinde ne meri maa ke haath toh kaat diye hai ... lekin meri maa ka aashirwad nahi kaat sakta woh', 'Itne saare grahak ... itne dino ke baad', 'Woh aayega aur zaroor aayega ... aur apne saath lekar aayega apne kahar ka toofan ... apne khroad ki aandhi', 'Ab hum uske saath khelenge ... haivaniyat ka khel khelenge', 'Teri aankhon mein dahekte angaaron ki saugand maa ... main tera har vachan poora karke rahoonga', 'Jung se dharti ka seena toh laal hota hi hai ... yeh desh ki atma ko bhi ghayal kar deti hai', 'Hum is desh ke bete hai, desh pe jaan luta denge ... gaddar mitayenge kya humko, hum gaddaron ko mita denge', 'Jab tak subah se shaam tak, sattar aadmiyon ko maar kar kha na loon ... dhakaar hi nahi aati', 'Tere paapon ki tujhe kitni sazaa milni chahiye uski hadh toh main nahi janta ... lekin aaj main tujhe itni sazaa doonga, itni sazaa doonga ki aane wali sadiyan bhi yaad rakhengi', 'Humse wafaadar rahoge toh maut tumse door rahegi']

['Kanoon ek aaisa hathyar hai joh sau achaiyon ko bhool jaata hai ... magar ek galati ho jaye toh gardan kaat deta hai', 'Marne waala chahe apne aap ko lohe ki deewaron mein bhi band karle ... bach nahi sakta ... aur jeene waala chahe lakhon goliyon ki bauchaar se guzar gaye ... mar nahi sakta', 'Hazar bura aadmi burai ka rasta akhtyar kare toh itna khatarnak nahi ... lekin jab ek achcha aadmi burai ka rasta akhtyar karta hai na ... toh burai ka seena bhi kaanp uthta hai', 'Doosron ko maarkar jeena koi gaurav ki baat nahi ... magar khud ko maarkar kisi aur ke liye jeena hi jeena hai', 'Tum aur hum kachre ke dher se uthne waali woh badbu hai ... jisko zamane ki naak kabhi seh nahi sakti ... aur kachra chahe kitna bhi saaf ho jaye usse badbu hi uthti hai', 'Kyun ki mera colour black hai, kaleja black hai aur uske andar ka khoon bhi black hai ... is liye main tujhe blackmail kar raha hoon', 'Jis tarah se bomb mein aag lagte hi saat second ke andar barood phatke bahar nikal jaata hai ... ussi tarah se Shambu saat dino ke andar jail ki char deewari se bahar nikal jayega']

['Kya mazaa baar baar milta hai tumhe humse rooth jaane mein ... roothne mein lagti hai do ghadiyan, umar kat jayegi manane mein', 'Har achcha aadmi, har naik aadmi jab burai ke andhere ko mitaane ke liye bahar nikalta hai ... toh burai ke kaale naag samne aake khade ho jaate hai', 'Main apni har cheez bhool sakta hoon ... lekin tumhare zindagi se judhi koi cheez kabhi nahi bhool sakta']

['Galati ek baar hoti hai, do baar hoti hai ... lekin teesri baar iraada hota hai', 'Kal hum Holi khelenge ... lekin is Holi mein gulaal ki bajai dhuna udhega ... pichkariyon mein se rang nahi, bandookon mein se goliyan niklengi ... geeton ki jagah cheekein ... aur laaj ki jagah laashein tadapengi', 'Dushman ko dushmani se hi nahi ... dosti se bhi maara ja sakta hai', 'Duty aur biwi mein khaas farak nahi hota ... dono ki maang mein laali bharni padti hai', 'Aaj ke baad mujhe agar kisi ke khilaaf koi bhi report mili ... toh main uska woh haal karoonga, ki maa baap bhi nahi pehchanenge', 'Hamara rasta kaatne waali koi bhi billi ... zinda nahi rehti', 'Joh jitna ooncha hota hai ... utni hi zor se zameen par girta hai', 'Budhape ko maut ka nahi ... akelepan ka darr hota hai']

Dialogues: ['Meri kamyaabi ke peeche ... tadbeer meri hai aur taqdeer meri maa ki hai', 'Jinke paas sirf pahunch hoti hai, unke paas kabiliyat nahi hoti ... meri pahunch meri wafaadari tak hai, meri imaandari tak hai, meri pahunch meri mehnat tak hai ... aur iske badaulat main apne mukaam par zaroor pahunch jaonga', 'Tune apni zindagi mein bade bade shaitan dekhe honge ... lekin aaj teri mulaqat shaitanon ke shahenshah Shaadilal se ho rahi hai ... jiske paas insaan toh kya, khud shaitan panah maangne aate hai', 'Mere baap ne mera naam Premanand is liye rakha hai ... ki main hamesha prem aur anand mein rehta hoon ... lekin jab koi hamara nuksaan karta hai toh hamara kroadh prem par haavi ho jaata hai ... aur hum dushmano ke liye Kroadhanand ban jaate hai', 'Sharafat se maan jayegi toh phool ki tarah soongunga ... zabardasti karni padi toh kaanton ki tarah kuchal doonga', 'Sachche pyar mein koi paap punya, achcha bura kuch nahi hota ... pyar bas pyar hota hai', 'Main is haramzade ki woh halat banaonga ki vaid aur hakeem bhi pareshaan ho jayenge aur soochenge ... ki thopda kaunsa hai aur haath pair kaunse hai']

['Aaisa toh aadmi life mein do-heech time bhaagta hai ... Olympic ka race ho yah police ka case ho ... tum kahe mein bhaagta hai bhai?', 'Hindu Muslim Sikh Isai ... sabhi toh hai bhai bhai', 'Apun bahut famous aadmi ... bada bada paper mein apun ka chota chota photo chapta hai']
['Marte marte main itna mar chuka hoon ... ki mujhe toh apne jeene par bhi shaq hone laga hai', 'Aapke anurodh pe main yeh geet sunata hoon ... apne dil ki baaton se aapka dil behlata hoon']

['Shehar kitna bhi ajnabee kyun na ho ... koi na koi toh apna mil hi jaata hai', 'Anaaj toh bahut pehda hota hai seth ... magar usse gareebon ke pet nahi tum logon ke godaam bhare jaate hai ... tabhi toh tum logon ki tijori mein rakha hua paisa nahi gina ja sakta ... magar gareebon ke jism ki pasliyan zaroor gini ja sakti hai', 'Duniya mein saare rishte mohabbat ke rishte hote hai ... agar mohabbat hai toh paraye bhi apne ho jaate hai ... agar mohabbat nahi toh khoon bhi khoon ko nahi pehchanta', 'Mujhe na chhedo yaaron main nashe mein hoon ... sheeshay mein main, main mein nasha, main nashe mein hoon', 'Jeena zaroori hai, jeene ke liye peena zaroori hai, peene ke liye jeena ... khair hum toh sharaab peete hai ... joh nahi peete, khaak jeete hai']

['Kutte ki zaat pehchanni ho toh uske aage haddi daal do ... aur aadmi ko pechanna ho toh usse daulat aur taqat de do', 'Kisi ki shab-e-vasl haste kate hai, kisi ki shab-e-hijr rote kate hai ... hamari yeh shab kaisi shab hai ki ya rab, na haste kate hai na rote kate hai', 'Bina mushkil mein padhe kamyabi milti bhi toh nahi ... mushkilen itni padhi mujhpar ki aasaan ho gayi', 'Mohabbat mein chirag-e-gul zamane ki hawa thandi ... chahe jitni bhi aag jale ishq ki, hawa thandi ki thandi']

['Is duniya mein apne zakhm dikhane nahi chahiye ... varna yeh log marham ki jagah usse namak se bhar dete hai', 'Malik ne hamari mitti kuch special kisam ki banai hai ... ki jis saanche mein dalo wohi roop dharan kar leta hai ... agar tange mein behta do toh tangewaala ban jata hoon, agar hawaijahaz mein behta do toh pilot ban jata hoon ... masjid mein mulla, mandir mein pandit ... aur agar dil mein behta do toh dilwaala', 'Goli ke bagair pistol bekaar hai ... aur akal ke bagair dono bekaar hai', 'Yeh haath bada ziddi hai ... gardan pakad le toh dum nikaal ke chhodta hai ... aur haath pakad le toh apna ke chhodta', 'Khuda meherban toh gadha pehelwan ... sambhal meri jaan ... ek hi vaar mein dikhaon Hindustan']

['Mard ka khoon aur aurat ke aasoon jab tak na bahe ... unki keemat nahi lagayi ja sakti', 'Bahaduri ka naya dhang sikha gaya hai koi ... chukake khoon ki keemat chala gaya hai koi ... Dharam aur Veer ka naam reh jaye dharti par ... sabak zamane ko aaisa sikha gaya hai koi', 'Manushya sari duniya par vijay prapt kar sakta hai ... lekin mrityu par vijay prapt kar nahi sakta', 'Aap jis roti ko sone aur chandi ke bartanon mein khakar ghamand ka dakaar lete hai ... hum gareeb ussi roti ko mitti ke toote phoote bartanon mein khakar bhagwan ka gun-gaan karte hai', 'Agar taqdeer mein maut likhi hai toh koi bacha nahi sakta ... agar zindagi likhi hai toh koi mai ka laal maar nahi sakta', 'Hum tumhe woh maut maarenge ki ek baar maut bhi kaanp uthegi']

['Jin rahon mein tum mere saath nahi chalogi ... vishvas karo un rahon mein bhatak-bhatakar main apni jaan de doonga', 'Madira ki dukaan mein gangajal ko bhi log sharab hi samajh lete hai', 'Do baimaan apas mein bade imaandar hote hai', 'Nazuk rishtey tootne ke baad ... kabhi nahi judhte', 'Joh doosron ki duniya andheri karte hai ... unki apni duniya mein bhi kabhi roshni nahi aati', 'Jab ek musalman apni haan par utar aata hai ... toh bade se bade shaitan ka muqabla kar leta hai', 'Musafir jab manzil se bhatak jaata hai ... toh waqt ki tapadein usse aur bhi gumrah kar deti hai', 'Nazaron se girne ke baad mandir ka devta bhi ... sirf ek patthar reh jaata hai']
['Satyam, shivam, sundaram ... policesam, arrestam, andarham', 'Insaan ko uske janam se nahi ... karam se parakhna chahiye', 'Sachai ka rishta khoon ke rishtey se ooncha hota hai']

['Kutta bhi jahan tukda khata hai wahan wafadari dikhata hai ... tujhe toh kutta kehna bhi kutte ki beizzati karna hai', 'Buzdilon ke haath se goli nahi chala karti ... jaan wohi le sakte hai joh jaan dena jaante hai']

['Jis din gareeb baghavat par utarta hai ... toh dhanwan toh kya usse bhagwan bhi nahi rok sakta', 'Tera husn meri taqat, teri tezzi meri himmat ... is sangam se joh aulad pehda hogi ... yun samajh aulad nahi faulad hogi', 'Gundon ka mazhab gundagardi hota hai', 'Koi aurat hokar bhi bandook utha leti hai ... aur koi mard hokar bhi chudiyan pehen leta hai', 'Sache insaan ko aag jala nahi sakti ... talwar kaat nahi sakti ... aur sache insaan ko zindagi ki takleefein rula nahi sakti', 'Agar kisi ki beti ki izzat ek baar lut jaye ... toh duniya ki sari daulat usse vapas nahi la sakti', 'Aaj ke baad aapka koi bhi aadmi yahan nazar nahi aana chahiye ... varna aaisi dhulai karoonga ki saath pushton tak aapki aulad ganji pehda hongi']

['Logon ko intezaar karvane ke baad mehfil mein jao toh taaliyon se swagat hota hai ... waqt se pehle pahunch jao toh khud taali baja bajakar aane waale ka swagat karna padta hai', 'Kanoon ke raaste mein agar koi aaye toh kanoon nahi tootna chahiye ... chahe rishtey toot jaye', 'Chashm-e-baddoor gar khush qadoqamat hogi ... aaj fitna hai chand roz mein qayamat hogi', 'Jab tab Bhavani Maa ka saaya mere saath hai ... dushman toh kya janam dene waala bhi nahi maar sakta', 'Record mein agar daag laga toh mitt bhi sakta hai ... lekin ek baar zindagi mein daag lag gaya toh kabhi nahi mitt sakta']

['Joh Baba ki taraf ek kadam badata hai na ... Baba uski taraf dus kadam badate hai', 'Shirdi mera Pandharpur, Shirdi pujya staan ... yahin viraje Vithal mere, saavare Ghanshyam ... yahin bahe Ganga Jamuna, yahi tirth mahan ... pranaam mera sweekar karo Sainath bhagwan', 'Sachche dil ki awaaz jab goonjti hai ... toh dishayen dol uthti hai', 'Science ka har ek naya experiment, har ek naya tajurba ... ek chamatkar hota hai', 'Guru sirf gyan hi nahi deta ... balki agyan bhi door karta hai', 'Jab insaan apne paap ka prayashchit khud karle ... toh usse kisi ke reham-o-karam ka mohtaj nahi hona padta', 'Bachchon ko is bhavna se padha ki woh phoolon se bhi zyada sundar bane, zyada mahek de ... aaise guloheen se toh mulk gulistaan banega', 'Insaan joh bane, jab bane, yog se bane toh sach hai ... swarth aur kamzori ke karan mahatma ka roop bhi dharan kare toh jhoot hai', 'Yaad rakhna bahut aasaan hai ... lekin bhoolna bahut bahut mushkil hai', 'Aatma nirodh rakhne ke liye ... vishvas aur sanskaron ka hona bahut zaroori hai']

['Purani zameen, purana makaan aur purana dost ... jitna zyada purana ho jaye ... utna hi zyada yaad aata hai', 'Waqt padne par aadmi jhoot bhi sach ki tarah bolta hai', 'Insaan marta aur jeeta sirf apne khayalon mein hai ... varna maut jaisi toh koi cheez hi nahi hai', 'Main zindagi mein kadve se kadva sach bardaash kar sakta hoon ... lekin meethe se meetha jhoot nahi', 'Aadmi har darr se bhaag sakta hai ... lekin apne aap se nahi', 'Aadmi bure se bure aadmi ka yakeen kar sakta hai ... lekin aurat zaat par bharosa nahi kar sakta', 'Arre kha le na yaar, kha le ... khali pet toh bhagwan ka naam bhi pet mein dard karta hai', 'Duniya mein kuch kaam aaise hote hai jinhe karne ke liye bhagwan insaan banata hai ... aur woh insaan utne hi bade hote hai, jitna bada bhagwan khud hota hai']

['Bhagwan jab dukh dard devat hai ... toh saath saath sehan shakti bhi devat hai', 'Ladki zindagi mein sirf do baar ghar chhodkar jaati hai ... ek baar jab apne maa baap ke ghar se uski doli jaati hai ... doosri baar apne pati ke ghar uski arthi uthti hai', 'Khamosh rehna aur chup-chap sab kuch sehne ka naam hi aurat hai', 'Hamare kaam mein joh aadmi hoshiyar nahi rehta ... woh kisi waqt bhi phas sakta hai']
['Pyar devtaon ka vardaan hai joh sirf bhagyashaliyon ko milta hai', 'Kaatilon ke aage koi rasta nahi hota ... sirf kanoon ki ek kali deewar hoti hai']

['Teri aankhon mein doobun, ya teri palkon se khel karun ... ya kho jaun teri zulfon ke jungle mein, ya apna dil rakh doon tere komal pairon ke neeche ... ab shuru kahan se ho jaun, yeh nahi samjh mein aata hai ... is beautiful manzar ke aage kiska bas chal pata hai', 'Yeh rang birange phoolon ke haar ka sehra hai, yeh Amal aur Rajni ke pyar ka sehra hai ... kitni khushi ki hai ghadi kaisi pyari baat ... aaj Rajni ke dwar aayi Amal ki baraat ... nazaren milke jhuk rahi hai haathon mein hai haath ... aaj se do jan rahenge milke ek saath ... yeh do dilon ke taaron ki jhankar ka sehra hai, yeh Amal aur Rajni ke pyar ke sehra hai', 'Rajni jise pyar se hum sab kahe cheeni ... chamke yun ghunghat mein joh badal mein chandni ... chupa rahi hoothon pe muskaan bhini-bhini ... sharmili aankhon mein hai sapno ki rangini ... yeh dulhan ke solah singaar ka sehra hai, yeh Amal aur Rajni ke pyar ke sehra hai ... itna aur kahenge tumse dulha bhai ... hamari cheeni toh hai khoye cheeni ki mithai ... pyar ki dhoop mein hai yeh kali khilayi ... ispe na aaye kabhi dukh ki parchai ... yeh pyar ke mausam sada bahaar ka sehra hai, yeh Amal aur Rajni ke pyar ka sehra hai', 'Bhagwan bahut acha hai tu, naari kya cheez banayi hai ... isko koi samajh na paya hai, sab duniya chakkar khayi hai ... arre yeh chakkar hi toh sab kuch hai, baki toh aata jaata hai ... woh yowan chullu mein layi, yeh ullu sher sunata hai ... is beautiful manzar ke aage kiska bas chal pata hai', 'Tere nainon ki khidki se yeh mujhko kaun bulata hai ... chandni ishara karti hai aur chand sitaar bajata hai ... pagalpan mein kuch kar baithun toh doshi mujhko mat kehna ... is beautiful manzar ke aage kiska bas chal pata hai', 'Bhool jao sab taaron ko, phoolon ko, bahaaron ko, aur yaad karo pehla chumban joh aag bhi tha aur sheetal bhi ... ab toh bas tum ho, roop tera, yowan tera, masti teri ... ab toh bas meri saansein hai teri palkon ko sek rahi ... bas do shareer ho jaye ek, dil itni baat manata hai ... is beautiful manzar ke aage kiska bas chal pata hai', 'Pyar ki shuruvat hai rota hai kya ... aage aage dekhiye hota hai kya', 'Tan dubla dubla, baal bikhare bikhare, aankhon ke neeche kaalik ... tumhari yeh haalat kisne ki balak?']

['Agar dukh na ho ... toh aane wale sukh ka aadmi maza bhi nahi le sakta', 'Insaan ka charitra uske safed kapdon se hai ... safed kapda subah pehna, agar shaam tak vaise hi rahe ... toh insaan ka dil sacha hai ... woh aadmi saaf hai ... bolo kya khayal hai', 'Kastoori ki mehak aur bhookhe ka chehra ... chupaye nahi chupta', 'Banakar faqeeron ka hum bhes ghalib ... tamasha-e-ahl-e-karam dekhte hai', 'Aadmi aaj ke zamane mein apna pet khud paal le ... wohi raja hota hai']

['Khoon teen kisam ke hote hai ... ek jis mein khoon behta hai ... doosra jis mein aansun behte hai ... aur teesra jis mein jazbaat beh jaate hai', 'Ek aurat sab kuch bhool sakti hai ... lekin yeh kabhi nahi ki uska pati kaun hai', 'Doctor dawaon se jism ka ilaaj karta hai aur physiatrist dimaag se dimaag ka ... dil ke paas pahunch kar, usse samajh kar, samjha kar', 'Ek ladki sab kuch bardasht kar sakti hai, lekin yeh kabhi nahi ... jisse woh chahe, kisi aur ko chahne lage', 'Yakeen ek dhaage ki tarah hota hai ... joh toot jaaye toh jud nahi sakta ... aur agar joda jaaye toh gaant padh jaati hai', 'Patte theek pad gaye toh jeet nahi toh haar ... jaise dil mil gaye toh pyar nahi toh takraar', 'Koi dil ke kitne paas hai yeh tab hi malum hota hai ... jab woh nazaron se door ho']

['Joh aurat kisi ke pyar ki kasam kha chuki ho ... woh paraye mard ke haath lagne se hi mar jaati hai', 'Lalach insaan ko ek pagal kutta bana deti hai ... joh apne malik ko bhi kaat leta hai', 'Khushi toh naam hai tumse nazar milane ka ... nazar milana ek bahana hai dil lagane ka', 'Har smuggler desh ka gaddar hota hai ... aur charas ka smuggler apne desh ka hi nahi ... sari insaaniyat ka dushman hota hai', 'Pyar ek panchi hai joh aasman ki bulandiyon tak udhna chahta hai ... magar insaan ke farz aur majbooriyan usse dharti se door nahi jaane deti', 'Mere dil mein toh ek jwalamukhi hai jiske dhadakte sholon mein ... in logon ko zinda jala dene ko jee chahta hai', 'When I kill them ... they stay dead', 'Tum asteen ke woh saanp nikle jiska kaata pani tak nahi maangta']

['Sharafat se baat karo taaki main tumhe sharafat se jawaab de sakon', 'Dil hai kahan ... woh toh tune le liya hai zalim', 'Tu sarkar aur janta ko lootta hai ... aur main tujh jaise looteron ko', 'Joh hamari jaan ka dushman na ho ... hum uski jaan nahin lete', 'Yahan joh bhi aata hai ... hamari marzi ki bagair bahar nahin jaata hai', 'Hamare samne koi doosra pistol rakhe ... yeh hum mein pasand nahin', 'Upar waala aaj tak jise na pehchan paya usse main kya pehchanuga']

['Kuch cheezein aaisi hoti hai, jinhe jitna door hatao ... utna hi kareeb aati hai', 'Jiska koi dost nahi hota ... uska koi dushman bhi nahi hota', 'Hum toh chamatkar ko namaskar karte hai', 'Qatta kijiye na taluk humse ... kuch nahi hai toh adawat hi sahi', 'Choron ke yahan chori ... chori nahi kehlati ... hera pheri kehlati hai', 'Jeet toh uss hi ki hoti hai ... joh aakhri baazi jeete', 'Mohabbat mein sawaal nahi kiye jaate', 'Saanp ki aulad ko kitna bhi dhood pilao ... aasteen ka saanp hi rehta hai', 'Ek din mein main ek hi daav lagata hoon', 'Yeh sher ki maa hai ... maine bakri ka nahi, sherni ka dhood piya hai', 'Husn ke daamo mein hum ... dost ko nahi bechne waale', 'Agar aaj shaam tak woh ghar wapas nahi lauta ... toh main dimaag ki jagah apne haathon ka istamal karoonga ... joh ki main yakeen se keh sakta hoon, utne hi tezz aur mazboot hai jitna ki mera dimaag', 'Hum, hum hai ... tum nahi', 'Kanoon ke haath kitne bhi lambe ho inspector sahab ... kisi sharif aadmi ke gelabaan tak kabhi nahi pahunch sakte', 'Naya khel, nayi taash', 'Kitna bhi bhaago, apni maut se nahi bhaag sakte ... aur tumhari maut mere haathon likhi hai', 'Manzil tak pahunchne ke liye hosh nahi ... josh ki zaroorat hoti hai']

['Kabhi raste mein mil jao toh katrakar guzar jana ... hum mein is tarah takna jaise pechana nahi tumne ... hamara zikr jab aaye toh yun anjaan ban jana ... ki jaise naam sunkar bhi hum mein jana nahi tumne', 'Meri zindagi ka har ek pal, tere husn se hai judha hua ... tere honth thirke toh subah hai, teri zulf bhikre toh raat hai', 'Mere dil ka woh hissa ... kambakht mera kab tha', 'Tera haath, haath mein ho agar ... toh safar hi asle-hayaat hai ... mere har kadam pe hai manzilein ... tera pyar gar mere saath hai', 'Daag daaman pe nahin ... dil pe liya hai maine', 'Is duniya mein aadmi insaan ban jaye ... toh bahut badi baat hai', 'Tum insaan ke roop mein devta ho ... yah devta ke roop mein insaan', 'Aapne kabhi apni aankhen dekhi hai? ... jahan dekhti hai ek rishta kayam kar leti hai', 'Kabhi kabhi mere dil mein khayal aata hai ... ke zindagi teri zulfon ki naram chhaon mein guzarne pati ... toh shadaab ho bhi sakti thi ... yeh ranj-o-gham ki shayahi joh dil pe chayi hai ... teri nazar ki shuaon mein kho bhi sakti thi ... magar yeh ho na saka ... magar yeh ho na saka aur ab yeh aalam hai ... ki tu nahi tera gham teri justaju bhi nahi ... guzar rahi hai kuch is tarah zindagi jaise ... isse kisi ke sahare ki aarzu bhi nahi ... na koi raah, na manzil, na roshni ka suraag ... bhatak rahi hai andhero mein zindagi meri ... inhi andhero mein reh jaunga kabhi khokar ... main janta hoon meri humnafas ... magar yoon hi kabhi kabhi mere dil mein khayal aata hai', 'Zindagi chand sawaal aur kuch jawaab hi toh bankar reh jaati hai', 'Main zara romantic kisam ka aadmi hoon ... shaadi ke baad ishq karna toh chhod diya hai ... is liye biwi se romance karke kaam chala leta hoon', 'Meri baat ka meri humnafas, tu jawab de ki na de mujhe ... teri ek chup mein joh hai chupi, woh hazaar baaton ki baat hai', 'Aap sooch kuch aur rahen hain ... pooch kuch aur rahen hain']

['Aaj ke zamaane mein toh baimaani hi ek aaisa dhanda reh gaya hai ... joh poori imaandari ke saath kiya jaata hai', 'Sara shehar mujhe lion ke naam se jaanta hai', 'Jhoot aksar bahut aasani se gaale se neeche utar jaata hai ... sach ko nighalna bahut kathin hai', 'Aashirwad toh bade aadmi dete hai ... hum toh sirf rai de sakte hai', 'Sher dildar hua karte hai aur kutte wafaadar ... na tum sher nikle aur na kutte', 'Aaj nag panchami hai kya? ... phir yeh saanp ko doodh kyun pila rahe ho?', 'Sar pe kafan bandhne waale kabhi maut se nahi darra karte', 'Is duniya mein ek aam aadmi achcha nagrik nahi ban sakta hai ... samjhe', 'Mard ke bachche aurat ke daaman se nahi ... sher ke panjo se khela karte hai', 'Jab sher aadamkhor ho jaata hai ... toh sarkar usse apni goli ka nishana banakar kutte ki maut maar deti hai', 'In sab logon ko mitti ka tel dedo ... varna tumhe issi tel mein jalakar mitti kar doonga main', 'Khopadiya kaat kar football nahi khela toh mera naam Kalicharan nahi']

['Aadmi chahe kitna bhi sangdil ho ... lekin uske andar ka insaan ekdum mar nahi jaata ... purani yaadein uska peecha nahi chhodti', 'Baat pistol ki goli hoti hai ... joh ek baar nikal jaye doobara vapas nahi aati']

['Sangeet cheez hi aaisi hai ... saaz ho ya awaaz, kaano mein padte hi dil ke taar jhun-jhuna uthte hai ... aur chanchal mann ko shanti mil jaati hai', 'Mere sapne ka sambandh aankhon se nahi hai, dil se hai ... jise mehsoos kiya ja sakta hai, dekha nahi ja sakta', 'Jeevan mein mahan wohi hota hai ... joh doosron ki muskaan ke liye apne aasoon pee le', 'Joh doosron ka adhikar cheenane mein kamyab nahi hote ... woh kisi na kisi tarah unki zindagi mein zehar bhar dete hai']

['Maika ladki ke liye ek sarai jaisa hota hai ... jahan aadmi raat bhar aaram toh kar sakta hai ... lekin zindagi bhar ka thikana nahi kar sakta', 'Bhagyawan wohi hoti hai joh do kandhon pe savaar apne babul ke ghar se jaati hai ... aur char kandhon pe savaar apne dulha ke ghar se nikalti hai', 'Shaadi ek yagya hota hai ... jis mein aadmi ko sukh paane ke liye apne ahankar ki aahuti deni padti hai', 'Nagin dushman ko maarne ke liye kabhi kabhi insaan ka roop dharan kar leti hai ... lekin tumhare jaisa insaan ki shakal mein naag aaj tak pehda nahi hua', 'Dil ke kuch taar aaise hote hai jinse woh khabaren bhi mil jaati hai ... joh bheji nahi jaati', 'Pati patni ka rishta faulad se zyada mazboot hota hai ... joh lakhon hathodon ke zor se bhi toda nahi ja sakta ... aur kabhi kabhi ek phool se zyada nazuk hota hai ... joh saans ki garmi se bhi ulaz-julaz jaye', 'Aankhon hi aankhon mein ishaare ho gaye ... hum tumhare aur tum hamare ho gaye', 'Yeh aankhen kisi aur ko dikhana ... varna tumhare is chaupte se yeh do button nikalkar apne kurte mein fit kar doonga', 'Duniya mein sabse buri aag badle ki aag hoti hai ... chahe woh kisi insaan mein ho ya janwar mein', 'Nastik ko aastik banana uparwaale ka bayen haath ka khel hai', 'Nagin ka nasha sharaab aur aurat ke nashe se zyada hota hai', 'Mard do zaat ke hote hai ... ek joh bewakoof pehda hote hai ... doosre joh bewakoof banaye jaate hai', 'Dharam ki aag se dil ke chirag jalte hai ... bhatakne waale issi roshni mein jalte hai']

['Kali dekhi thi, ab gulzar hai tu ... churi dekhi thi, ab talwar hai tu', 'Duniya bhi kitni ajeeb jagah hai ... jinhe hum chor, gunda aur badmaash kehte hai ... woh insaaniyat ke liye daulat ko thukra dete hai ... aur jinhe hum nek, shareef aur baizzat kehte hai ... woh daulat ke liye ek bachche ko apne baap se alag kar dete hai', 'Kahin bhi apna thikana nahi is zamane mein ... na aashiyane ke bahar, na aashiyane mein', 'Woh kaali kaali botalein joh hai sharaab ki ... arre raatein hai in mein band hamare shabaab ki', 'Jhamela char din ka tha, hawali they mawali they ...
