['Rajneeti ke vachan samay ki zaroorat dekhkar diye jaate hai ... aur ussi tarah samay ki zaroorat dekhkar todh diye jaate hai', 'Yeh azaadi ki ladai mere mar jaane se khatam nahi hogi ... yeh ladai toh mere mar jaane ke baad shuru hogi ... aur us waqt tak ladi jaati rahegi jab tak yeh Bharat maa ke bichade hue bachche maa ki ghod mein vapas nahi chale jaate', 'Jail ki deewar ko todkar bhaag jaana aasaan hai ... lekin prem aur dosti ki deewar ko phandna namumkin hai', 'Aadmi zindagi aur maut dono se jhoot bol sakta hai ... lekin apni premika se nahi', 'Pyar jab nafrat mein badal jaata hai ... toh khatarnak ho jaata hai', 'Dosti aur wafaadari ka saboot baaton se nahi ... kaam se diya jaata hai', 'Yahan suraj hamari aagya lekar nikalta hai aur chand hamare ishare se doobta hai ... hamare liye aane waale kal aur guzar jaane waale kal mein koi fark nahi ... dono hi hamare ghulam hai', 'Devta ki mahaan shakti apne bhakton ki hamesha raksha karti hai']

['Zindagi ki har badi ladai insaan apne aap se hi ladta hai ... apne hi andar insaan Mahabharat jaisi kahi ladaiyon se guzar jaata hai', 'Pooche joh koi mujhse bahaar kaisi hoti hai ... naam tera leke keh doon yaar aaisi hoti hai', 'Meri mohabbat ka tum yakeen karlo ... kahin na umar guzar jaye aazmane mein', 'Yeh nazar unki nazar se aaisi takrayi ki bas ... hosh rukhsat ho gaye woh bekhudi chai ki bas ... zulf bikhri aur lipatkar mere dil se reh gayi ... meri duniya khushbuon se aaisi mehakai ki bas', 'Zindagi bankar nasha kuch aaisi lehrai ki bas ... kya kahoon har saans ne woh aag badkai ki bas ... dillagi kuch der ki, haai ban gayi dil ki lagi ... baaton baaton mein yahan tak baat badh aayi ki bas', '(Koi ladki tumse nahi takrai?) ... Takrai ... takrake gabrai, gabrake sharmai, upar se uski mummy chali aayi ... is liye ladki haath nahi aayi']

['Babumushoi, zindagi badi honi chahiye ... lambi nahin', 'Babumushoi, zindagi aur maut upar waale ke haath hai ... usse na toh aap badal sakte hai na main ... hum sab to rangmanch ki kathputliyan hai jinki dor upar waale ki ungliyon mein bandhi hai', 'Jab tak zinda hoon tab tak mara nahi ... jab mar gaya sala main hi nahi', 'Hum aane waale gham ko kheench taan kar aaj ki khushi pe le aate hai ... aur us khushi mein zehar ghol dete hai', 'Kab, kaun, kaise uthega ... yeh koi nahin bata sakta hai', 'Maut toh ek pal hai', 'Yeh bhi toh nahi keh sakta ... meri umar tujhe lag jaye', 'Jeena toh Bambai mein ... marna toh Bambai mein', 'Maanta hoon ki zindagi ki taqat maut se zyada bhadi hai ... lekin yeh zindagi kya maut se bhattar nahi', 'Anand mara nahi, Anand marte nahi', 'Marte marte chela guru ko jeena sikha gaya', 'Aaj tak tum bolte aaye aur main sunta aaya ... aaj main bolonga aur tum sunoge', 'Maut tu ek kavita hai ... mujhse ek kavita ka vaada hai milegi mujhko ... doobti nabzon mein jab dard ko neend aane lage ... zard sa chehra liye chaand ufak tak pahunche ... din abhi paani mein ho raat kinaare ke kareeb ... na andhera, na ujala ho ... na abhi raat, na din ... jism jab khatam ho aur rooh ko jab saans aaye ... mujhse ek kavita ka vaada hai milegi mujhko']

['Zindagi badi ajeeb hai, bahut ajeeb hai ... yeh sab kuch bhula deti hai ... aur phir bhi sab kuch yaad rehta hai isse', 'Agar humein apne dukh pe rone ka haq hai ... toh phir apne sukh par hasne ka adhikaar bhi toh hai', 'Zindagi mein yaadien honi chahiye ... lekin yaadon ko zindagi na banao', 'Gale pada hai gorakh dhanda ... ek chor hai, ek hai andha']

['Yeh botal hai na botal ... yeh duniya ki har sundar ladki se zyada khoobsurat hai ... poocho kyun ... kyun ki yeh dhoka nahi deti, chaalbaazi nahi karti', 'Sabzi tarkari garam garam ... arre malik kare hazam hazam', 'Yeh jagah bilkul veerana hai ... yahan koi kitna cheekhe chillaye ... uski awaaz ya toh cheel kauve sunenge ya yeh veerana ... aur phir yeh awaaz hamesha ke liye khamosh ho jayegi', 'Jab koi kisi ke liye bahut kuch karta hai ... toh ek naa bahut bada ghaav bhi lagati hai']
['Khuda gharat kare motor banane waale ko ... sach kaha zalim ghar se beghar kar diya is saale motor chalane waale ko', 'Jab mann mein pachtava aata hai toh saare paap dhul jaate hai']

['Aurat agar apne aapko mitakar purush ke charano ki dhool ban sakti hai ... toh sataaye jaane par shool bankar uska jeena bhi haram kar sakti hai', 'Nari gyan maha gyan hai ... iske bina sare gyan adhoore reh jaate hai ... is liye har mard ko chahiye ki is gyan ka poora poora adhyaan kare', 'Pati ka mann jeetne ke liye stri ka jhukna hi stri ki jeet hai', 'Pehla bacha abhi nahi ... do ke baad kabhi nahi', 'Narazgi se narazgi kabhi door nahi hoti', 'Ilahi sooratein kya kya banayi hai zamane mein ... ke har soorat kaleje se laga lene ke kabil hai']

['Jab aurat ka dil tootta hai, toh woh apni sari zindagi un tukdon ko baantene mein kharch kar deti hai ... aur jab mard ka dil tootta hai, toh woh apni sari zindagi un tukdon ko sametne mein', 'Jua khelna hi ek pagalpan hai ... aur asli jua khelne waala khiladi hota hai', 'Lucky in gambling and unlucky in love', 'Aadmi ki khoobsurati uske kaam se pehchaani jaati hai ... uski shakal se nahi', 'Zindagi mein kuch ehsaan aise bhi hote hai ... jinki keemat asal se zyada sood mein chukana padti hai', 'Rangeen zamana hai mausam suhana hai, chhodo bhi ab yeh sharam ... nazarein joh karti hai nazaron se baatein, chal woh karen baat hum', 'Cha gaya humpe nasha jalwa dekhkar joh tera ... woh gaya woh gaya woh gaya, hai dil mera', 'Jhoomte masti kesu tere lache lache ... in adaaon pe teri mar gaye achche achche', 'Jeene na degi aankhen teri dilruba mujhe ... in khidkiyon se jhaank rahi hai kazaa mujhe']

['Ek aurat ki zindagi mein motor, banglay, dhan, daulat, in sab cheezon ki koi keemat nahi ... usse sirf ek acha pati chahiye joh usse pyar kare ... aur jiske kadamon mein woh apni duniya rakh de', 'Is duniya mein do taang waala janwar sabse khatarnak janwar hai', 'Bijli giri Musharabad mein aur ghar jala Moradabad mein', 'Haara hua juari aur bighada hua raees bahut khatarnak hota hai', 'Suhaag ki raat sirf do shareero ka hi nahi ... do dilon ka, do jeevano ka sangam hota hai']

['Mere aur tumhare darmiyan sirf itna faasla hai ... ki ek jhappad dunga aur tumhare yeh saare adarsh jiska tum log itna dum bharte rehte ho, bahar girke hawa mein gayab ho jayenge', 'Main jin logon se kamata hoon ... pehle unke dil ko tatollta hoon aur bad mein unki jeb ko', 'Hamare paas camere ka bahana nahi, lekin dil mein zaroor chhap leke jayenge aapki']
['Kutte aur aadmi ki nasal kaan kheench kar hi pata chalti hai', 'Yeh whiskey soda agar aap peeyega ... toh whiskey soda andar aur aapka dum bahar']

['Dushmani ko khareedne kahi jana nahi padta ... aur dosti kisi bhi keemat pe nahi milti', 'Agar hum apne buzurgon ki nakhushi ki buniyaad par apni khushiyon ki imaarat khadi karenge ... toh woh zyada din nahi tik payegi', 'Do suiyon ke beech zindagi kya kya khel dikhaye ... naya purana natak karta waqt guzarta jaye', 'Aadat kisi bhi kisam ki ho achchi ya buri ... uska ghulam hona buri aadat hai', 'Jab jeb thandi hoti hai toh dimaag garam ho jaata hai', 'Naya kitna hi naya kyun na ho ... uski buniyaad purani hoti hai', 'Joh aaj naya hai, kal purana ho jayega ... joh aaj purana hai, kal naya bankar samne aayega', 'Na zehan mein aap, na rum mein aap ... dono jahan pukar aaye, kahan hai aap ... itna guroor husn pe achcha nahi janaab ... humko lagalo dil se samajhkar yahi kitaab']

['Haste huye insaan ke saath saari duniya hasti hai ... lekin jab woh rota hai toh akela rota hai', 'Talash zindagi ka doosra naam hai ... kisi ko rozi ki talash hai aur kisi ko chain aur sukoon ki', 'Har dayaar mein aati hai phir bahaar ... khilte hai phool bhi wahan daur-e-fiza ke baad', 'Main joh chahta hoon woh paata nahi ... aur joh paata hoon woh sirf ek ittefaq hai']
['Jabbar Singh ne sirf do hi baatein seekhi hai ... ek mauke ka fayda uthana ... aur apne dushman ka naam aur nishaan mitta dena', 'Jiska mann saaf hota hai ... uski nazar bhi saaf hoti hai']

['Gulshan parast hoon mujhe gul hi nahi aziz ... kaanto se bhi nibah kiye ja raha hoon main', 'Hawa badal gayi hai aaisi kuch zamaane ki ... duayen maangta hoon hosh mein aane ki', 'Joh kali dulhan bani hai woh chaman ki jaan hai ... par dahej joh kuch mila hai, jung ka samaan hai ... aap meri toop hai aur sasur captaan', 'Haya se sar jhuka lena, ada se muskura dena ... haseeno ko bhi kitna sehal hai, bijli gira dena', 'Chaman mein ikhtalat-e-rangboo se baat banti hai ... hum hi hum hai toh kya hum hai ... tum hi tum ho toh kya tum ho', 'Zara si der ho jayegi toh kya hoga ... ghadi ghadi na uthao nazar, ghadi ki taraf', 'Khilte hai gul yahan khilke bhikharne ko ... milte hai dil yahan milke bichadne ko', 'Jee haan baza huzoor kiye ja raha hoon main ... aur maska laga lagake jeeye ja raha hoon main', 'Lajja hi stri ke mann ka darpan hota hai', 'Chup nahi sakti chupane se mohabbat ki nazar ... chahane waale bhi rakhte hai qayamat ki nazar']

['Agar duniya mein maut se badi sachai koi nahi ... toh sach maniye aapko dhoka dekar meri zindagi bhi maut se kam nahi', 'Jise dost ka haath thaam le aur maa ka aashirwad mil jaye ... woh zindagi ki har manzil tay kar sakta hai', 'Zameen toh kisi ke baap ki nahi hai ... zameen toh bhagwan ki hai, mehnat kisaan ki aur anaaj saare desh ka hai', 'Main jhoot bolkar bhi pachtai ... aur sach bolkar bhi pachtati rahoongi', 'Ek maa ke dil ka sabse bada armaan ... bete ka byah hota hai', 'Jiyo toh sabke liye ... maro toh sabke liye', 'Zindagi ki mushkil marke asaan nahi hoti  hai ... himmat se asaan hoti hai', 'Kanoon ka matlab agar mulzim ko sazaa dena hai ... toh begunah ko sazaa se bachana bhi', 'Jhoot bolkar khud pachtane waala ... sach bolkar kabhi kisi ko pachtane nahi deta', 'Is waqt meri maa, mera dharam, mera bhagwan ... joh kuch hai paisa hai', 'Main janta hoon joh kuch bhi isne kiya usse koi maaf nahi kar sakta ... bhagwan bhi nahi ... lekin ek maa maaf kar sakti hai', 'Ab mera rasta maut ki thokar bhi nahi rok sakti', 'Main maut se nahi darti ... maut se usse darr lagta hai jise zindagi se pyar ho ... aur zindagi se usse pyar hota hai jise zindagi ne kuch diya ho']

['Mujhpar tere roop ka jaadu hai bekaar ... kaam hai tera naachna, naach bhare darbar', 'Payal waali ruk wahin, na ho bahut magroor ... moorakh hai joh chal padhe, apni hadh se door', 'Woh toh chalte hai seena ubharke ... kyun na loote maaze vasl-e-yaar ke']

['Basakar dilon ko mittati hai duniya ... hasakar hamesha rulati hai duniya', 'Tune sab paaya hai, aashiq ki nazar paayi nahi ... jabse dekha tujhko duniya ki taraf dekha nahi ... jabse chaha tujhko apni yaad bhi aayi nahi ... tukhjo paana zindagi hai, tujhko khona maut hai ... aur kuch iske sivah mere fasaane mein nahi ... maang loonga mein khuda se yah chura loonga tujhe ... tujhsa moti doosra uske khazane mein nahi', 'Laila ke aangan mein joh bhangra ho gaya ... Majnu naacha aur yoon naacha ke langda ho gaya', 'Kya milega bhala rulaake mujhe ... paoge kya jala jalake mujhe', 'Yun toh duniya ne bhi teer maare bahut ... yaad aayenge ehsaan tumhare bahut', 'Khuchal doonga, masal doonga, jala doonga, loota doonga ... rulaya mujhko kismat ne ... main duniya ko rula doonga', 'Chedke dil ke tootte taaron ko, ab tum uski sadaa se darte ho ... khud hi toofan uthaye hai tumne, aur khud hi hawa se darte ho', 'Tere zakhm meri tadap se harre hai ... meri aankh mein tere aasoon bhare hai', 'Dhongi shaadi ka tumne rachaya fisool ... na kiya na karoongi yeh rishta kabool', 'Sab apni soochte hai, sabko dhyan hai apna ... yahi hai rang toh poora na hoga ek sapna', 'Layega mere dil ki tadap, koi kahan se ... sunna hai mera haal, sunno meri zabaan se', 'Ishq jis mein basa nahi rehta ... aaise dil mein khuda nahi rehta', 'Tu jab aa jaati hai paas ... bhook mar jaati hai, jaag uthti hai pyaas', 'Kaunsi gutthi hai woh joh humne suljahi nahi ... aaisi fariyaad aaj tak darbar mein aayi nahi', 'Sharmati hai kyun aaj meri baahon mein aake ... le jaonga ek din tujhe doli mein bithake', 'Kyun matakti hai bahut ... aaj tanhayi khatakti hai bahut', 'Zara yeh raat dhalne de, nasha tera utaroonga ... jawaani bhool jaye ishq, tujhko aaise maroonga ... andhere mein agar maara toh kehlaonga main buzdil ... tadap le raat bhar, pehli kiran hogi teri kaatil', 'Meri subahon ko roshni dedo ... meri shaamon ko chandni dedo ... mujhko tum meri zindagi dedo', 'Usse kehna ke tum mera ek khwab ho, joh chamakta hai dil mein woh mahatab ho ... usse kehna ke gehuyon ke kheton ka rang, tilmilati hui titliyon ki umang ... usse kehna ke jharnon ka chanchal shabaab, ghat ki taazgi, aabroo-e-janab ... usse kehna ke jhoolon ki angdaiyan aur udhte dupatton ki shenaiyan ... usse kehna ki chakki ke geeton ki aag, ladkhadati jawaani, machalta suhaag ... usse kehna ke dulhanon ke kajal ki pyaas, pehle bhose ki garm aur thandi mithaas ... itni ranginiyon ko jab ikhja kiya, Heer kudrat ne tab tujhko pehda kiya', 'Kya khadi baatein banati hai ... khuda ka khauf kar, kyun aag is ghar mein lagati hai ... zara soorat toh dekh apni, tujhe Raanjha satayega ... tu jis raste se guzregi, woh us raste na jayega', 'Koi ladki dabaav mein aake, darke, majboor hoke, ghabrake agar hui ho nikaah par raazi ... shaadi jayaz nahi hai woh qazi', 'Baarat mein halki si jhalak apni dikhake ... chhoda mujhe is husn ne deewana banake ... doori na hui dil ko kisi tarah gawara ... chhod aaya hamesha ke liye takht hazara', 'Milke tanhai ka ehsaas usne doona kar diya ... dil kiya aabad kuch aaise, ki soona kar diya', 'Mohabbat ka tamasha ishq ki taseer dekhoge ... mere seene mein dil mein Heer ki tasveer dekhoge', 'Chand ubharta hua, bujhte huye chehre dekho ... chandni chhitki hai, cha jaye andhera jaise ... is tarah tootkar bhikre hai zameen par sapne ... lut gaya ho kisi baraat ka dera jaise', 'Haqeeqat khul gayi teri ki tu kaisa gavala hai ... kamine dushmano ke gaon ka tu rehne waala hai', 'Doli se main jab utroongi hairan na hona ... mar jaon khushi se toh pareshan na hona', 'Doori kabhi palbhar ko gawara na karenge ... agar jee na sake saath toh hum saath marenge', 'Jhoot ki boo tumhari baat mein hai ... lao koi gawah saath mein hai?', 'Ishq se joh bacha nahi rehta ... woh kisi kaam ka nahi rehta', 'Chandni aanchal mein bhar layi hai tu ... raat yeh chamki hai jab aayi hai tu', 'Meri nazar ne husn ka jadoo jaga diya ... tujhko sajaake aur bhi katil bana diya', 'Makkhiyan behte na kyun kabar pe saudai ki ... uski mashooq thi beti kisi halwai ki', 'Humse na kar mastiyan, mar gayi kya teri bhabhiyan ... ek do bhi nahi aath hai, tabhi toh iske yeh thaat hai', 'Hum mein lagi hai joh thokar, tu muskurata hai ... yeh waqt woh hai, ki dushman bhi raham khata hai', 'Sui aur wagi lo aur pyar ke dhaage ... seeyo kapde pehenke jinko jadoo jism ka jaage', 'Jawaani ek din humpar bhi aayi thi ... kisi se pooch le, us waqt bhi mehnat ki khai thi', 'Sochne ke waqt kahan, yeh koi aur gul khilayegi ... baat jungle ki aag hoti hai, lakh rokoge phail jayegi', 'Raah ke kaanton se bhi ab ishq ghabrata nahi ... kya qayamat hai kahin dil ko karaar aata nahi', 'Kismat hai ki zinda bach gaye pyare ... na jaane dakuyon ne is jagah kitne jawaan maare', 'Na tumko fikar, na bhai ko gham gharane ka ... khayal aaya kabhi mera ghar basaane ka ... diya kahin mera pehghaam, tumne cheddi baat ... zara bhi ki kabhi koshish, sajje meri baraat', 'Jism-e-nazuk mein jaan khuda ki hai, mooh ke andhar zubaan khuda ki hai ... jab bhi bologe sach hi bologe, varna hargiz zubaan nahi khologe', 'Ek umeed kahi rang se lehrai hai ... dil mein aayi hai toh duniya mein bahaar aayi hai', 'Tu kya bolega deewane ... hamare ghar mein pehda ho gaya tu kaise, kya jaane', 'Koi mujhpar taras nahi khaata, koi patthar pighal nahi paata ... koi sunta nahi meri fariyaad, ek main aur saikadon jallad', 'Gazab ki maang hoti hai joh dil ko maang leti hai ... ek aaisi taang hoti hai joh dil ko taang deti hai', 'Shaadi ki tamanna thi kunware chale aaye ... jaise gaye vaise hi bechare chale aaye', 'Jaise taise taalo isse ... lula landa jahan koi mil jaaye haath peele karo, nikalo isse', 'Tumne sar par isse chadaya tha, tumne itna kiya hai isko kharab ... tumhi har baat iski sunte the, tumhi dena biradari ko jawab']

['Mere paas car hai lekin main phir bhi bekaar hoon', 'Mard ko apni aurat par aur aurat ko apne mard par yakeen hona chahiye ... toh hi family happy ho sakti hai', 'Khat ka mazmoon bhap lete hai lifafa dekh kar ... naam ko bhi jaan lete hai qayafa dekh kar', 'Aapke chehre par aaya hua gussa, jaise chand pe chahe huye chote se badal ki tarah ... aapka mann jal ki tarah nirmal ... aapka dil phool ki tarah komal ... aur aapka swabhav "aaahhhh"', 'Duniya mein har insaan ko do cheez ki bhook hoti hai ... ek daulat ki aur doosri mohabbat ki']

['Vidhata ne jab jeevan aur mrityu ke daurahe par doobara lakar khada kar diya hai ... toh is khel ko jeevan ki baazi lagakar hi khatam karoonga', 'Paisa insaan ko woh cheez nahi de sakta joh usse shiksha se milti hai ... izzat ... shiksha insaan ko izzat ke saath jeena sikhati hai', 'Izzat hamare jeevan ka updesh hai ... daulat toh sirf jeene ka sadhan hai', 'Sui ke is chote se chhed mein se oont jaisa bhari bharkam janwar guzar sakta hai ... magar ishwar ke raj mein daulat ka pujari kabhi nahi ja sakta ... kyun ki wahan daulat ka koi mol nahi', 'Izzat ke bagair insaan ka jeevan, mrityu samaan hai']

['Johny bure kaam toh karta hai lekin imaan ke saath', 'Bure kaam karte karte buri aadatein padh hi jaati hain', 'Insaan badi cheez ke liye kisi waqt bhi choti cheez ko chhod sakta hai', 'Jis roz ek chor doosre chor pe bharosa nahi karega ... uss roz bhagwan bhi Allah miya pe bharosa nahi karenge', 'Jawani ayaashi ka ek khoobsurat mauka hai', 'Aadmi ke jab burre din aate hai ... toh uski akal maari jaati hai', 'Tumhare liye chaand bech sakta hoon ... lekin imaan nahi', 'Woh aadmi pehda nahin hua ... kabhi na kabhi jiski neeyat na doli ho', 'Woh ladki, ladki kya ... joh bade se bade aadmi ki neeyat ko dolne pe majboor na kar de', 'Insaan sirf ek hadh tak bardaash karne ki taqat rakhta hai ... aur takleef hadh se bahar ho jaaye ... toh uska har ussool sheshay ki tarah toot tootkar girne lagta hai']

['Na koi tarang hai, na koi umang hai ... meri zindagi bhi kya ek kati patang hai', 'Apnepan ke liye kisiko apna banana zaroori nahi ... jisse bhi apnapan mil jaye wohi apna hai', 'Agar sharaab dukhon ko mitta sakti ... toh har aadmi sharaabi ban jata', 'Kavita se mann ko behlaya ja sakta hai ... samjhaya nahi ja sakta', 'Pyar apni jagah hai, daulat apni jagah hai ... zindagi ke liye dono zaroori hai', 'Aandhi mein udhte hue patte ko kya malum ... usse kahan se kahan bhatakna hoga', 'Main joh aag lagata hoon ... usse bhujana bhi jaanta hoon', 'Kailash khud nahi sochta ... doosro ko majboor karta hai sochne ke liye', 'Ghar mein devi jaisi bahu hai, toh phir tirth yatra ki kya zaroorat?', 'Jab ghar ki jawaan bahu bahar rang raliyan manati phire ... toh budhe sasur ko neend kaise aa sakti hai', 'Bhagwan ki kaisi anokhi leela hai ... kabhi sab kuch cheen leta hai ... kabhi bahut kuch de deta hai']

['Apne yahan ki mitti ki khushboo hai na ... woh toh ajnabi logo ki saanson mein bhi sanskar bhar deti hai', 'Yahan maa baap ke liye aulad sab kuch hai ... aur aulad ke liye maa baap?', 'Agar tumhare maathey ki bindiya aur maang ka sindoor, suhaag ki nishani nahi kalank hai ... toh mitta do isse', 'Desh pe marne waala, kabhi nahin marta', 'Beti ke aasoon dekh kar bhi yadi pita ka dil na roye ... toh woh dil nahin patthar hai', 'Tum usse apna samajhte ho, joh madad leta hai ... main usse apna kehta hoon, joh madad deta hai', 'Sharam yahan ka sabse anmol gehna hai', 'Shareer jitna thanda hoga, jalne mein utna hi anand aayega', 'Abhi shareer mein garmi hai beta ... jab thanda ho jaye toh jhauk dena aag mein', 'Jahan life partners badal sakte hain ... toh naam kyun nahi?', 'Jab yahan se jao, toh itne kalank saath lekar mat jaana ... jinhe Ganga maiya bhi na dho sakey', 'Jab paschatap nahi ... toh prayaschit bhi nahi']

['Har saas yeh bhool jaati hai ki woh bhi kabhi bahu thi ... aur har bahu yeh bhool jaati hai ki usse bhi ek din kisi ki saas banna hai', 'Hai Ram kya waqt aa gaya hai ... maa ki shiksha ka amrut bhi beti ko zehar lag raha hai', 'Meri zabaan se ughla hua zehar bhi amrut ban jaata hai', 'Maya Devi toh meri bachpan ki saheli hai ... hum ek doosre ke naakhun tak pehchante hai', 'Insaan jab aadmiyon se mayoos ho jaata hai ... toh phir kutte aur billiyon se pyar karne lagta hai', 'Meri chaati par aakar toh saanp bhi rassi ban jaata hai', 'Kavita toh atma ki khuraakh hoti hai ... achcha sher sunne ya kehne se dil aur dimaag saaf ho jaate hai', 'Agar aadmi ko galati karne ka adhikar hai ... toh galati karke pachtane ka haq bhi hai', 'Saas kisi ki bhi ho ... sab ek jaisi hoti hai', 'Zindagi bhar nahi bhoolegi woh barsaat ki raat ... maine jab pakda tha kambakht teri saas ka haath', 'Mohabbat ek tam-tam hai joh daudai nahi jaati ... bhadak uthti hai apne aap hi, bhadkai nahi jaati', 'Khoob phulegi phalegi beti Harparsad ki ... baap ne toh karke shaadi zindagi barbaad ki', 'Purani haddiyan badi mazboot hoti hai', 'Nagan khubsoorat hoti hai ... par das bhi deti hai', 'Hum apne pote ka dada banenge ... tabla, sarangi aur baja banenge', 'Duniya mein kisi ko gaali dena shayad paap na hoga ... lekin gareeb ko baar baar gareeb aur mohtaj ko baar baar mohtaj kehne se bada kukarma aur koi nahi hai', 'Mohabbat ko mile aasoon wahan se ... sitare banke aate hai jahan se']

['Main marne se pehle marna nahin chahta', 'Cancer ke keedon ke samne ... na meri zindagi ki koi keemat hai ... na tumhare aasuon ki', 'Hum the jinke sahare, woh hue na hamare ... doobi jab dil ki naiyya, samne the kinare', 'Tum shamshaan mein bujhi chitta ki rakh mein zindagi dhoond rahi ho', 'Yeh toh main hi jaanta hoon ki zindagi ke aakhri mod par kitna andhera hai', 'Main tumhe tumse zyada jaanta hoon']

['Dil insaan ka sabse bada dost bhi hai ... dushman bhi', 'Aurat woh haseen paheli hai jisse samajhne ke liye insaan baar baar galati karta hai ... magar phir bhi samajh nahi paata', 'Insaan badal jaate hai ... insaano ke naam nahi badalte', 'Jis tarah main apne pyar ko ruswa nahi kar sakta ... us hi tarah apne farz ko bhi sharminda nahi kar sakta']

['Tumhe dekhte hi mere dil ka diwala aaisa nikal gaya hai jaise kisi satodiya ka nikal jaata hai ... aur mere jeevan ka karobar poora beh gaya hai ... yeh tabhi chalega jab tum apne prem ka finance mujhe dogi', 'Bhagwan ki bhi kya leela hai ... kisse kiska saath kahan chhuda deta hai aur kahan mila deta hai', 'Yeh badi badi aankhen, yeh rasile honth, yeh gora gora rang ... jism hai ki samundar ki leheren ... yahan uthti hui, yahan girti hui, yahan uthti hui, yahan girti hui ... jee chahta hai bas dekhta hi rahoon', 'Ladkiyan do tarah ki hoti hai ... ek tumhare jaisi jiske aate hi ghar mein ujala ho jaata hai ... aur doosri woh jiske jaate hi ghar mein diwala ho jaata hai', 'Tumhe dekhne ke pehle mera dil is aaine ki tarah bilkul kora tha ... jabse tumko dekh liya tumhari tasveer is dil ne kheench li', 'Haath bhi diya, zubaan bhi di, dil bhi diya ... ab haath chhodana nahi, zubaan se phirna nahi, dil todna nahi', 'Bhagwan aur chahe kuch banaye ... par aadmi ko pagal na banaye']

['Yeh mitti pyasi hai, jis din iski pyaas bhuj jayegi ... yeh mitti sona ban jayegi', 'Mein kal ke bare mein kabhi bhi nahi sochti ... ho rahega kuch na kuch ghabrayen kya ... zindagi sirf ek ittefaq ka naam hai', 'Hamare haath se naseeb waale hi marte hai', 'Sahare insaan ko kamzor bana dete hai']

['Mann ko jalane se dukh door nahi hota hai ... dukh ko toh koshish karke bhulana padta hai', 'Apne bachchon ke khatir kabhi na kabhi har maa ko rona padta hai ... koi aasoon bahakar roti hai aur koi aasoon peekar', 'Prem mein mazaa hi tab aata hai jab ladki gusse waali ho', 'Ek chota sa zakhm bahut gehra daag ban sakta hai ... aur ek choti si mulaqat jeevan bhar ka saath ban sakti hai', 'Desh ke liye jaan nyochavar karne waalon se toh maut bhi darti hai', 'Aaj main sari duniya ke samne sar uthake keh sakta hoon ... najane kitne janam lene ke baad, najane kitni tapasya ke baad ... tum jaisi maa, tum jaisi devi ka beta ban saka', 'Yakeen nahi aata toh poocho in barfilay pahadon se, in nadi ki leharon se, in baharon se ... hum dono ke dilon ki awaaz ek hai, joh saath saath milkar in vaadiyon mein goonj uthegi', 'Kuch din pehle hum ek doosre ko jaante tak nahi the ... aur kuch hi dino mein do se ek ho gaye ... aur ab kuch hi dino mein teen', 'Ghar mein ghusne ke liye ghar ke naukar ko pehle patana chahiye']

['Sharif aadmi England toh kya kisi bhi land mein chala jaye ... apni motherland ko kabhi nahi bhoolta', 'Ek sharif aurat zindagi mein ek hi baar pyar karti hai ... yeh kali ek hi baar khilti hai ... ek baar nigahen milti hai ... ek baar mohabbat hoti hai', 'Naari aur sangeet ka bahut kareeb rishta hai ... dono mein narmi hai, loch hai, lachak hai, dard hai, soz hai, tadap hai, khichav hai, kashish hai', 'Yeh komal kali, naazon ki pali, misri ki gali ... hamare hi kul mein lagegi bhali', 'Aaj bajegi shehnai, ghar mein aayegi lugai ... main tere baap ka banoonga jamai']
['Tera haath, haath mein aa gaya ... ke chirag raah mein jal gaye', 'Tu mere samne hai ... teri zulfein hai khuli, tera aanchal hai dhala ... main bhala hosh mein kaise rahoon, kaise rahoon']

['Jis tarah jhoot jhoot chilakar sach ko jhoot nahi banaya ja sakta ... us hi tarah sach sach chilakar jhoot ko sach nahi banaya ja sakta', 'Taleem aur libaas se aadmi ki appearance badli ja sakti hai ... uska character nahi badla ja sakta']

['Insaan jab gunaah karta hai toh sazaa sirf ussi ko milti hai ... lekin jab woh shaadi karta hai, toh uska asar sare ghar par hota hai ... chahe woh acha ho, chahe bura', 'Jinka dil maila hota hai, unhe har baat maili nazar aati hai', 'Har khoobsurat ladki pehle se hi apne aap par aashiq hoti hai ... jab koi ladka sahi tareeke se tareef karta hai, toh woh ussi par aashiq ho jaati hai']

['Main ek aurat hoon mitti ka dher nahi ... jiski joh chahe shakal bana li, jahan jee chahe rakh diya', 'Koi bhi pauda itni jaldi bada nahi hota jitni jaldi ke ladki', 'Door se main aap nazar aata hoon ... zara paas aa jaon toh baap nazar aata hoon ... aur bhi paas aa jaon toh phir potato chaap nazar aata hoon ... aur agar bilkul paas aa jaon toh phir chup-chap nazar aata hoon']

['Aandhi aaye ki toofan koi gham nahi ... hai yahi aakhri imtihaan saathiyon', 'Tiranga ek nishaani hai ... Hindustan ke ekta ki, Hindustan ke izzat ki aur Hindustan ke taqat ki', 'Aye meri sundar aankhon waali mehbooba ... apni lambi kaali zulfein mat bikhra ... kyun ki in mein hazaron kaale naag bandhe hai ... in zulfon ke jaal mein mujhko mat uljha']

['Wahan ka zarra zarra apni halat par salamat hai ... tumhare ek na hone se wahan lekin qayamat hai', 'Jis desh mein humne janam liya hai ... us desh mein sachai ki puja hoti hai ... sach ke sivah zubaan par kuch nahi aa sakta', 'Aye meri jaane-jigar, patthar ka seena cheerkar, sari deewarein todkar, sabko akela chhodkar ... toofano se lad jaonga, tujhko magar le jaonga aur apne ghar jake garam garam chai pilaonga ... aur reh jayenge sab taapte, ek dujhe ka mooh taakte ... band karke raste aur tumhare vaste gajar ka halwa laonga', 'Jab bhi hamari tumhari mulaqat hoti hai ... koi na koi baat zaroor pehda hoti hai']

['Punjab, Sind, Gujarat, Maharashtra ... Bangal ho ke Hyderabad ... Hindustan ke hum hai ... Hindustan hamara', 'Ladki khandan ki ek band mutthi hai ... jab tak yeh mutthi band hai sharafat, sharafat hai ... jis din yeh mutthi khul gayi ... ek shareef ladki aur ek bazaari aurat mein koi farak nahi', 'Agar ek biwi chali gayi toh doosri biwi mil sakti hai ... chattees saas sasure mil sakte hai ... magar ek sacha dost nahi mil sakta hai', 'Sachai se kahin zyada kabhi kabhi masoom sa jhoot dil ko bada baahta hai', 'Zevar utaarkar phir se pehne ja sakte hai ... lekin ghar ki izzat woh zevar hai joh ek baar utar gayi toh phir nahi pehni ja sakti', 'Yeh desh ek ghar aur tamaam sube uski mili-jhuli deewarein ... agar yeh deewarein alag alag ho jaye ... toh chhat, chhat nahi rahegi ... dar, dar nahi rahega ... ghar, ghar nahi rahega', 'Main all in one hoon ... main driver ka motor hoon ... main coach van ka ghoda hoon ... mail maali ka bhageecha hoon ... main kitchen ka bawarchi hoon', 'Apne liye zinda rehna sirf zindagi hai ... aur doosron ke liye zinda rehna sirf zindagi hi nahi ... balki ibaadat hai, bhakti hai', 'Agar koi jawan potti jawan potte ko maarengi toh ... potta mar jayenga lekin potte ka dil joh hai fadhakta rahenga ... fatafat-fhat fatafat-fhat', 'Dawa khali shareer ke hadh tak asar karti hai ... magar dua dil ke gehraiyon se hoti hui bhagwan tak pahunch jaati hai', 'Talwar ka zakhm bhar jaata hai ... lekin zubaan ka zakhm nahi bharta']

['Yeh aap log taaliyan baja rahe hai ... yah rummy ke patte baant rahe hai', 'Saanp ko fann uthane se pehle kuchalna, main achchi tarah janta hoon', 'Anyay ki kaali raat khatam ho rahi hai ... aur nyay ka suraj nikalne waala hai']

['Aadmi ke paon mein agar koi zanjeer na ho toh uske liye ghar aur bahar, done ek se hai', 'Meri zindagi mein aate toh kuch aur baat hoti ... yeh naseeb jagmate toh kuch aur baat hoti', 'Main dekhta hoon sach hai kahin khwaab toh nahi ... yeh weham tera hai dil-e-betaab toh nahi', 'Ek sache dost ke rishtey mein, maa, baap, aur bhai behen ka pyar bhi shamil hota hai', 'Jahan na jaaye ravi, wahan pahunche kavi', 'Koi sau baar milkar bhi paraya hi rehta hai ... aur koi pehli hi baar milkar apna ho jaata hai', 'Kisi ki nazar ka joh bismil nahi hai ... woh kehne ko dil hai, magar dil nahi hai', 'Yaad-e-maazi azab hai ya rab ... cheen le mujhse hafiza mera']
['Jab hawa shabd ko badalti hui pehlu aayi ... muddaton apne badan se teri khushboo aayi', 'Apni aankh ka shateer bhi tinka nazar aata hai ... aur doosron ki aankh ka tinka shateer nazar aata hai']

['Bhagwan jin do aatmaon ko ek bandhan mein band dete hai ... wohi sansar mein janam lekar vivah bandhan mein bandte hai', 'Shahi talwarein mohabbat ki gardan par chalti rahi hai ... lekin mohabbat ka naam hamesha roshan hota raha hai', 'Aashiqkon ki chittaon par lagenge har baras mele ... ishq par marne waalon ka yahi baqi nishaan hoga', 'Har dam duayen dena, har lamha aahen bharna ... unka bhi kaam karlo aur apna bhi kaam karna', 'Chinta mat karo ... chinta karna bhagwan ka bharosa khona hai', 'Murghe jaisi taange inki, bandar jaisa chehra ... yeh joh mere ghar aayenge baandke sar pe sehra?']

['Zindagi ki khushi duniya ko pa lene mein nahi ... apne aap ko kho dene mein hai', 'Joh kho diya uska gila nahi mujhe ... joh kabhi pa saka tha bas uska naaz hai', 'Wahin hai duniya, wahin hai swarg mera ... jahan tum ho, jahan tum ho, jahan tum ho', 'Zindagi ki asli khushi doosron ko khush karke haasil ki jaati hai', 'Jawani ka mausam zindagi bhar nahi rehta ... jab tak hai aao dhoom machate hai', 'Insaan yaadon ke sahare nahi, umeedon ke sahare jeeta hai ... log mitt jaate hai, zindagi nahi mitati ... woh hamesha aage badti rehti hai, kisi naye sahare ke umeed mein']

['Zindagi mein jis cheez ki tamanna ho usse logon mein baant do ... dhan chahiye dhan do, sukh chahiye sukh do, pyar chahiye pyar do ... sirf do aur dete raho ... kabhi kisi se kuch maango mat bas aankh bandh karke diye jao, diye jao', 'Aurat ke aanchal mein kutumb ki, desh ki, insaan ki aabroo hoti hai', 'Jeevan ke sare sapne vishvas ke bal par hi toh sache hote hai', 'Jis desh ki ladkiyan besharam ho jaati hai ... wahan ke mardon ko sharam aane lagti hai ji', 'Pyar maangne ki cheez nahi hai ji ... dene ki cheez hai']

['Apne mann mein base hue purush ko nikalkar ... bhagya se paye hue pati ko devta maan lena nari hi kar sakti hai ... issi liye Bharat ki nari ko devi kaha jaata hai', 'Aatma aur parmatma, tapasya aur vardaan, dharm aur satya ke beech bahut kam antar hai ... phir bhi usse paar karne ka maarg bahut lamba hai', 'Raakh ko koi kitna bhi dehkai ... woh aag nahi ban sakti', 'Ankahi bahut si baatein hai ... kuch keh lenge, shayad kuch reh jayengi', 'Is duniya mein jiske haath mein talwar hai ... wohi jee sakta hai', 'Birha ki aag mein jalte hue purush ki hridaya ki jwala ... updesh ke ghee se nahi bhujti ... usse prem, daya, mamta ke gangajal se hi shaant kiya ja sakta hai']

['Dil paya albela maine ... tabiyat meri rangeeli ... aaj khushi mein maine bhai yahan ... thodi si bhaang peeli', 'Tumhare pati ka naam tha Dwarka ... maal peeta tha woh pehli dhaar ka ... utaara na le neembu ka na achaar ka ... phir bhair kaise na badhe bekaar ka', 'Dil ka sauda mehanga ho ya sasta ho ... yaar ke lab se gaali khalo baansi ho ya khasta', 'Jeevan mein jab bhi koi bada parivartan aata hai toh insaan ka swabhav aaise hi ho jaata hai ... kisi anjaan modh par pahunchkar woh ... baar baar pichle raaston ki taraf mudhkar dekhta hai', 'Hamara khoon ka rishta zaroor hai ... magar ab nibhane ka nahi ... sirf khoon bahane ka rishta reh gaya hai', 'Jab tumhari soorat aankhon mein lekar aankhen band karti hoon na ... toh phir kholte hue dar lagta hai ... kahin tum ojhal na ho jao', 'Prem ka khel do dhaari talwar hai ... iska khiladi kabhi khud bhi ghayal ho jaata hai', 'Kisi ko paap ki drishti se dekhna ... maha paap hai', 'Yaar ki mehfil mein kab ki patt chuki gandheriyan ... jhadoo lekar aaye hai shayad uthane bediyan']

['Duniya mein do cheezein aaisi hai jinhe koi bhi nahi chupa sakta ... ek husn aur doosri daulat', 'Mashooq mere saath hai, boat mere haath hai ... dil mein armaan hai, jigar mein toofan hai', 'Andhera wohi hota hai ... jahan roshni dikhane waala koi nahi hota', 'Jisne Paris mein mohabbat nahi ki ... woh duniya mein kahin nahi kar sakta']

['Jab dil mein khushi ho na ... toh sadiyan bhi minuton mein khatam ho jaati hai', 'Jab aurat ke haath mein kaanta ho toh dil mein phool khilte hai ... jab haath mein phool ho toh dil mein kaante chubte hai', 'Kaaba na sahi, butkhana sahi ... hum chahne waale tere sanam, tujhe dhoond hi lenge kahin na kahin', 'Dil sadda hai Hindustani, camera sadda je Japani ... te photo khichega suhani']

['Samaaj mein rehke samaaj se bair nahi kiya ja sakta', 'Tujhe dekha, tujhe chaaha, tujhe puja maine ... bas itni khatta hai meri, aur khatta kya', 'Jeevan bhar sada buddhi ke sahare nahi jeeya jata ... kuch pal aise bhi aate hai jab shraddha ka sahara lena padta hai']

['Insaan insaan ko maaf kar deta hai ... kabhi kabhi bhagwan bhi insaan ko maaf kar deta hai ... magar insaan ki bhool usse kabhi maaf nahi karti ... saza dekar hi chhodti hai', 'Mere barbaad ghar mein tune kyun mashaal jalayi thi ... meri tareek raaton mein ujala banke aayi thi', 'Main ishq hoon ... ishq jisne seekha nahi duniya mein kisi se darna ... jisne seekha hai agar kuch toh mohabbat karna ... husn ke naam par mitt jana, fanaa ho jana ... jaan se khelna, tasveer-e-wafa ho jana', 'Mohabbat shehad bhi hai, zehar bhi, talwar ka gham bhi ... yeh woh zalim maseeha hai ke zakhmi ho gaye hum bhi', 'Dagabaazi agar karni thi ulfat kyun jatayi ... jafaaon ne teri bedard seena jaag kar dala ... simatghar bewafa tune jala kar khaak kar dala', 'Hum toh actor log hai, wah pe zinda hai ... dekhne wale wah na kare, toh dil se aah nikalti hai', 'Fareb de gayi Adam ko kya hai aurat bhi ... siyaahkhana bana dala isne jannat bhi']

['Jab aap chalti hai toh raaste ke patthar bhi phool ban jaate hai', 'Kasam lelo joh mehfil mein tumhe danista dekha ho ... nazar aakhir nazar hai beirrada uth gayi hogi ... tajub kya lagi agar aa gaye Meena ji seene mein ... hazaron dil mein angaray bhare the, dab gayi hogi']

['Chup chup se woh behte hai, aankhon mein nammi si hai ... nazuk si nigaahon mein nazuk sa fasana hai', 'Humein hamari hi soorat dikha gaya koi ... hasi-hasi mein hi pagal bana gaya koi', 'Sabse bhayanak janwar aadmi hota hai ... bas usse darna chahiye', 'Main ek aise desh mein pehda hua hoon jahan mohabbat karne walo ki umar dekhi jaati hai ... unke baalon ka rang dekha jaata hai ... unke dil ka rang koi nahi dekhta', 'Ek lafz-e-mohabbat ka itna hi fasana hai ... simte toh dil-e-aashiq, phailey toh zamana hai']

['Zameen toh maa hoti hai ... aur maa ke tukde nahi kiye jaate', 'Shehar mein rehkar, nayi roshni mein palkar ... hamara libaas badal sakta hai ... hamari sabhyata toh nahi', 'Vishvas toh ek aaisa bandhan hai ... joh ek insaan ko doosre insaan ke kareeb lata hai', 'Aap hamare paseene se logon ka khoon chooste hai', 'Yeh dharti ek aaisi hatheli hai ... jis par kisaan hal chalakar, insaan ke taqdeer ki lakeerein kheenchta hai', 'Logon ke paas tann dhakne ko kapda nahi ... aur inhe tann dhakne ka shaunk nahi', 'Ration par bhashan bahut hai ... lekin bhashan par ration koi nahi']

['Sarkari sadak hai yeh tera ghar toh nahi hai ... hum kyun na kare ishq, tera darr toh nahi hai', 'Teri tasveer mein tujhse bhi ek khoob nirali hai ... lipat lo jitna jee chahe, na gussa hai na gaali hai', 'Na jaane log lakhpati crorepati kaise ban jaate hai ... apna toh pati banana mushkil ho raha hai', 'Pyar ki raah mein na kadam rakhne se pehle socha jaata hai ... na kadam rakhne ke baad', 'Daulat kabiliyat nahi paida kar sakti ... magar kabiliyat daulat pehda kar sakti hai', 'Nigahein woh ki raahgiron pe jinke vaar hote hai ... yeh achchi sooraton waale musafir maar hote hai', 'Raah par unko laga laye toh hai baaton mein ... aur khul jayenge do chaar mulaqaton mein']

['Aaisi nafrat bhi achi nahi ... joh ghate toh nafrat aur bade toh mohabbat ban jaye', 'Jaise sugandh ke bina phool adhoora reh jaata hai ... waise hi naari ka jeevan bina jeevan saathi ke adhoora reh jaata hai', 'Nasha pilake girana toh sabko aata hai ... aare mazaa toh tab hai ki girton ko thaam le saakhi', 'Nar ka naari se, phool ka phulwari se aur mandir ka pujari se hamesha ek hi naata rehta hai ... aur uska naam hai dharam', 'Jab itni bewafai par tujhe dil pyar karta hai ... aare zalim agar tu bawafaa hota toh kya hota', 'Fall from a hilltop, fall from above, fall from anywhere ... but never fall in love', 'Badhi dilchasp ghaflat ho gayi hai ... haai achanak unse ulfat ho gayi hai']

['Bhagwan ne kitni achchi tarah tumko sajakar is duniya mein behja hai ... aankhen jaise jheel mein khile hue do kamal ... dekhti hai toh aakash mein indradhanush khil uthte hai ... sharamati hai toh kaliyon ka sar jhuk jaata hai', 'Meri zindagi mein ek aag lagakar tum bhi chain se nahi jee sakogi ... tumhari aatma til-til karke jalegi aur tumhe sukh ka ek saans bhi nahi milega', 'Maine tumhari mohabbat ko ishwar ka vardaan samajhkar seene se lagaye rakha ... aur uske badle mein tumne mujhe kya diya? ... apni bewafai ka yeh zehar ... yeh zehar jisne meri nas-nas mein nafrat aur inteqam ke jwalamukhi bhar diye', 'Joh haath tumhari madad ko uthega ... main us haath ko kaatkar phenk doonga ... joh chhat tum logon ko aasra degi ... main us ghar ko jalakar raakh kar doonga', 'Aurat ki izzat uska dharam hota hai', 'Hazaron beh gaye in botalon ke bandh pani mein ... glasson mein joh doobe phir na ubhare zindagani mein']

['Kahin sher aur nagma bankar, kahin aasoonyon mein dhalkar ... woh mile mujhe toh e-dil, kahin sooratein badalkar', 'Pyar ki seema sirf issi duniya tak nahi ... pyar toh bhavnaon ka ek aaisa phool hai ... joh ek janam se doosre janam aur phir janam janam tak mahekta rehta hai', 'Humko toh gardish-e-haalat pe rona aaya ... rone waale tujhe kis baat pe rona aaya?', 'Naukri milne ke baad kaam rahe na rahe ... lekin naukri dhoondna bahut bada kaam hai', 'Sach joh kisi ki jaan lele ... usse kahin achcha hai woh jhoot joh kisi ko maut ke mooh se bacha le', 'Dil ke paas rehne waala jab door chala jaata hai ... tabhi pata chalta hai hum usse kitna pyar karte hai', 'Aadmi kitna hi bura kyun na ho ... woh kabhi na kabhi zaroor pachtata hai', 'Ameeri aur gareebi ke darmiyan yeh joh fasla hai na ... yeh sadiyon se badta hi ja raha hai ... isse koi kam na kar saka', 'Joh paa lene ko pyar kehta hai ... usse hazaron lakhon janam lene padenge pyar ka matlab samajhne ke liye', 'Insaan par duniya pehre laga sakti hai ... magar pyar par nahi']

['Fakira khada dukaan par, maange sabki khair ... na kahu usse dosti, na kahu usse bair', 'Fakira jama nadi mein, sabki maange khair ... ho gayi dosti Mahesh se, ab na raha khandan ka bair', 'Daulat dekar insaan khareede jaate hai, imaan khareede jaate hai ... magar kisi ke mann mandir mein base hue bhagwan nahi khareede jaa sakte', 'Ajeeb waqt mohabbat mein aaye jaate hai ... woh hum mein aur hum un mein samaye jaate hai', 'Yeh zindagi ki mehfil, mehfil mein hum akele ... daaman ko koi chume, zulfon se koi khele', 'Butane mahwaz ujadhi hui manzil mein rehte hai ... ki jiski jaan lete hai, us hi ke dil mein rehte hai', 'Dane dane par likha hai khane waale ka naam ... woh teri hai aur teri hi rahegi subah shyam', 'Khili thi dhoop-e-harsam aur pani barasta tha ... jab tu paida hua toh teri maa roti thi aur baap hasta tha', 'Raat bhar anda pakaya, phir bhi woh kacha reh gaya ... mar gaye shayar, lekin ullo-ka-patha reh gaya', 'Ajab hoti hai yeh jhooti mohabbat ... zabardasti main phuslaya gaya hoon ... main apni maa se darkar bhaag aaya ... main khud aaya nahi, laya gaya hoon', 'Mohabbat bhare dil ka salaam kubool farmaiye ... meherbani hogi naam bataiye', 'Koi mooh chum lega is nahi par ... shikhar reh jayegi yunhi zabi par']

['Chand tasveer-e-butaan, chand haseeno ke khutoot ... baad marne ke mere ghar se yeh samaan nikla', 'Saaya palkon ka na chug jaye tan-e-nazuk mein ... unse kehta hoon joh aankhon mein basa karte hai']

['Tel mein woh baat kahan joh is meethi muskaan mein hai ... tel toh sirf diye ki loh bhadkata hai ... aur yeh meethi muskaan toh dil mein jwalamukhi bhadka deti hai', 'Jiske paas hunar ki daulat ho woh kisi daulat ka bhookha nahi hota', 'Haaye, nazar toh barood hai bilkul ... sach kehta hoon yehi nazar meri chitta par daal dena ... bagair lakdi ke bhasm']

['Milap ki teen manzilen hoti hai ... pehli manzil nafrat aur ladai ... doosri manzil dosti aur safai ... teesri manzil pyar aur sagai', 'Duniya mein bahut si aaisi baatein hoti hai joh namumkin nazar aati hai ... lekin agar insaan himaat se kaam kare aur woh sachcha hai ... toh jeet ussi ki hoti hai', 'Jab koi nadaan ladki pyar ki manzilon se guzar jaati hai ... apni izzat aur abroo kho beheti hai ... toh anjaam zindagi nahi, maut hota hai']

['Jab tak mehnat karne waale haath aur sapna dekhne waala dimaag ek nahi ho jaate ... ek hi manzil par pahunchne ke liye hum sab mein se koi aage nahi badh sakta', 'Ek din sabko marna hai ... nahi marta toh do cheez ... life aur death']

['Aap log kaun hai, kyun hai, kahan se aaye hai, kyun aaye hai, kisse milna hai, kyun milna hai ... agar is waqt nahi aate toh kya bighad jaata?', 'Daulat jahan nehmat hai ... wahan ek bahut badi laanat bhi hai']

['Musibat aur zindagi ka kehte hai chitta tak ka saath rehta hai', 'Na sukh hai, na dukh hai, na deen hai, na duniya, na insaan, na bhagwan ... sirf main hoon, main hoon, main hoon, main ... sirf main', 'Lagta hai aaj har ichcha poori hogi ... par mazaa dekho ... aaj koi ichcha hi nahi rahi', 'Jis jagah ko dekh kar parmatma ki yaad aaye ... woh tirth kehlata hai ... aur jis aadmi ke darshan se parmatma mein bhakti jage ... woh Mahatma kehlata hai', 'Jab matlab se pyar hota hai ... toh pyar se matlab nahi rehta', 'Yaad mein nasha karta hoon aur nashe mein yaad karta hoon', 'Joh aadmi apne naseeb ko kosta rehta hai ... uska naseeb bhi usko kosne lagte hai', 'Maut ek khayal hai jaise zindagi ek khayal hai', 'Kaam uska, naam tera', 'In logon ko mujhpe vishwas hai ... aur ab mujhe inke vishwas pe vishwas hone laga hai', 'Dukh woh amrit hai jisse paap dhulte hai', 'Main zubaan se lafzon ki tasveer khenchta hoon ... atith toh sab dikhate hai, main kabhi kabhi bhavishya bhi dikhata hoon', 'Gandi naali se nikla hua pani ... kabhi Gangajal nahi ban sakta']

['Raat mein soote hue joh sapne aate hai, woh sache nahi hote ... lekin din mein jaagte hue joh sapne dekhe jaate hai, woh hamesha sache hote hai ... kyun ki unka doosra naam hai irrada', 'Ek achche hospital ke liye sirf pakki imaarat aur chamakte hue furniture ki zaroorat nahi ... zaroorat hai to kaam karne waale haathon ki aur mehsoos karne waale dil ki', 'Duniya abhi tak woh bandook nahi bana saki joh sachai ka khoon kar sake, nekki ko khatam kar sake', 'Doosre ke ghar ka cheena hua diya ... apne ghar mein kab tak ujala de sakta hai', 'Jab jab insaan ke haath nek kaam karte hai ... unhe jalna padta hai, chaale padte hai ... phir aaise hi haathon par pyar ka marham lagta hai']
['Ameer se uski daulat aur gareeb se uski izzat cheen lo ... toh hamesha hamesha ke liye mar jayega', 'Libaas badal dene se aatma nahi badal jaati']

['Watan pe marne waale marte nahi ... amar ho jaate hai', 'Duniya ke barbaadi ki jadh hai ... ek insaan ka doosre insaan pe hukumat karne ka shauk', 'Joh insaan ki maut marna nahi jaanta ... yeh duniya usse insaan ki zindagi jeene nahi deti', 'Yeh veer kitne mahaan hai jinhone is desh ki mahaanta ko adarsh ka roop diya ... mahaan hai yeh desh jis mein aaise veeron ne janam liya', 'Apne desh ke liye ek baar marna ... sau janam ke barabar hota hai']

['Sangeet ke liye masti ki zaroorat hoti hai, aur mast hone ke liye sangeet ki ... aur kavi banne ke liye sangeet ki bhi aur masti ki bhi', 'Biwi woh cheez hai joh narak ko swarg, aur swarg ko narak bana sakti hai', 'Prem ki pukaar agar sau-fi-sadi sach nahi hai ... toh isse bada jhooth duniya mein koi nahi ho sakta hai', 'Tarannum woh ke joh dil se chale toh lab-e-shayar mein jaadu sa bhar de ... magar hothon se jab goonje fiza mein toh zameen aur asmaan ko ek karde', 'Main awara sifat ka kya bataun, jahan behatun meri mehfil wahin hai ... mohabbat hai jahan bhi zameen pe, main shayar hoon meri manzil wahin hai', 'Aye chasm-e-tamasha jhoom zara, ab waqt nazara aa pahuncha ... Kashmir mein do din jeene ko Kashmir ka maara aa pahuncha', 'Joh lakhon karodon ke samajh mein aa jaye wohi meri zubaan hai ... joh lakhon karodon ko bha jaye wohi mera jazba hai ... mera dil na Hindu hai, na Musalman hai, na Sikh hai, na Isaai hai ... mera dil insaan hai, mera dil Hindustan hai', 'Mohabbat ki kahani kuch aisi hi hoti hai ... kabhi baat banti hai, kabhi banne se pehle hi bighad jaati hai', 'Jab nahi hoti ho toh mujhe yaad aati ho ... aur jab hoti ho toh aisa lagta hai ki ho nahi', 'Tum aam hote huye bhi khaas ho ... mitti mein baste huye bhi sona ho']

['Jinke apne ghar sheeshay ke hoon ... woh doosron par patthar nahi phenka karte', 'Waqt hi sab kuch hai ... waqt hi banata hai ... aur waqt hi bighadta hai', 'Kismat hatheli mein nahi ... insaan ke baazuon mein hoti hai', 'Hum wahan hai jahan se humko bhi kuch hamari khabar nahi aati ... aage aati thi haale dil pe hasi, ab kisi baat par nahi aati', 'Yeh bachchon ke khelne ki cheez nahi ... haath kat jaye toh khoon nikal aata hai', 'Main jitni mohabbat karta hoon ... utni nafrat bhi kar sakta hoon']

['Daulat gareebi ki taraf dosti ka haath toh bada sakti hai ... magar usse gale lagate hue hich-kichati hai', 'Mohabbat jisse ek baar gale lagale ... usse juda karte hue maut ke haath bhi kaanp jaate hai', 'Husn ki shaan mein ho jaye na kuch gustakhi ... tum chale jao, tumhe dekh ke pyar aata hai', 'Dhobi ki dhulai, darzi ki silai, Roopraja ki padai, us par itni mehangai ... aur sirf do sau ki kamai ... duhai hai duhai']

['Hum mein apna ilaaj-e-dard-e-dil karna bhi aata hai ... hum aaise jeene waale hai jinhe marna bhi aata hai', 'Phoola chaman khushi ka jaane bahar aaya ... aankhon ka noor aaya, dil ka qaraar aaya ... dekhe joh khwab dil ne, tabeer hai yeh unki ... humko bhi zindagi ka ab aetbaar aaya ... joh phool-e-ilahi, hasta rahe hamesha ... joh bagh-e-zindagi mein bankar bahar aaya', 'Aaj sheeshay mein bar bar unhe dil ki moorat dikhai deti hai ... apni soorat nazar nahi aati, meri soorat dikhai deti hai', 'Ab tak na khabar thi mujhe ujhade hue ghar ki ... aap aaye toh ghar be-sar-o-saman nazar aaya']

['Do akele mil gaye toh ek sansar ban jayega', 'Humne gareebi mein sapne dekhe hai ... yeh sapno mein bhi gareebi nahi dekh sakegi', 'Yeh mere do haath jab bhi uthenge pattharon ko tarashne ... yeh goonj har baar milan ka geet bankar sunai degi ... tumhe vishvas dilane ki tum mere paas ho, mere dil mein']

['Jism jawaab de nahi sakta jab tak andar himmat ki chingaari hai', 'Yeh hamara desh, yeh Budh, Ashok, Gandhi, aur Nehru ka desh hai ... shanti ka pujari zaroor hai, lekin buzdili ka kayal nahi', 'Agar zindagi hai toh tumse juda na ho ... aur agar maut ho toh tumse juda hone se pehle', 'Tum kahan se aaye ho aur kahan chale jaaoge, mujhe malum nahi ... tumhara yakeen karun ya na karun, mujhe malum nahi ... par dil kehta hai ke jab tum paas ho ... toh aur kuch nahi, koi nahi chahiye']

['Jeet inki nahi hogi, jeet janta ki hogi ... jeet is jhoot ki nahi hogi, jeet sachai ki hogi ... jeet in khooniyon ki nahi hogi, jeet hum begunahon ke khoon ki hogi', 'Doobti hui kashti mein bhaagne waale kabhi sahil ka mooh tak nahi dekhte', 'Charon taraf dekhte hai toh har baat mein khot aur milavat ... nal ka pani pejiye toh us mein dawai ki milavat hai, saans lijiye toh hawa mein millon ke dhuan ki milavat hai, agar khana khaiye toh roti ke aate mein mitti ki milavat hai ... charon taraf har baat mein jhoot hai ... dua mein, salaam mein, pyar mein, nafrat mein, gusse mein ... sab mein jhoot hai', 'Meri haseen mehfil mein, ishq patthar hai aur kuch bhi nahi ... apne nagamo se zindagi de isse, ya mitta apni zindagi bhi yaheen', 'Aye haseen aasman ki malika, mera dildar mujhko lauta de ... tujhko apni nazakaton ki kasam, tu mera pyar mujhko lauta de', 'Zindagi ka kya bharosa hai ... kaun jaanta hai kab maut kis darwaze se dhakil hoti hai ... kab in chalti hui saanson ka silsila toot jaata hai']

['Dukh tumne mujhe nahi diya hai ... maine apne aap ko dukh diya hai', 'Aaj itni derr ho gayi ... kabhi darwaze ko dekhte the kabhi waqt ko ... na tum aate the na waqt jata tha', 'Sab kuch khuda se mang liya tujhko mangkar ... uthte nahi hai haath mere is dua ke baad', 'Roye toh yaar ke kandhe par ... jaaye toh yaar ke kandhe par', 'Hum toh dil ke saudagar hai ... dil khareedte hai ... dil bechte hai', 'Sangam toh woh hai jahan dil, dil se milta hai ... atma, atma se milke paramatma ho jati hai', 'Aaj tak mujh mein sach kehne ki shakti nahi thi ... aur aaj tum mein sach sunne ki shakti nahi hai']

['Marne wale ke saath koi mar toh nahi jaata', 'Sab cheezein intezaar kar sakti hai ... magar ek khoobsurat ladki ko kisi ka intezaar nahi karna chahiye', 'Ab hamare darmiyan sirf ek parda hai joh saaya banke haqeeqat ko chupaye huye hai ... aur woh parda tum ho ... tum ho, tum ho, tum ho', 'Mujhe khoon acha lagta hai']

['Aadmi jab tak zindagi mein kuch ho na jaye ... uske apne bhi paraye ho jaate hai', 'Chota kaam kare toh mochi aur bada kare toh Bata ... chota kaam kare toh julaha aur bada kare toh khambata', 'In haathon ki mehnat se joh pasine ki boond dharti pe girti hai ... woh moti bankar laut aati hai', 'Peet ka bhai kaam nahi aata ... pet ka bachcha kaam nahi aata ... aakhir pallu ka paisa hi kaam aata hai']

['Jeet gaye toh kya kehna ... haare bhi toh baazi maat nahin', 'Taqdeer buri ho toh ilm bhi dhaara reh jaata hai', 'Na joru na jaata, Allah miyah se naata', 'Kehne ko toh fitna hoon, magar main hoon qayamat ... aji is kalam ke ustre se bana deta hoon badhe badhon ki hajamat', 'Charah gar chhod tere bas ka nahin rog mera ... sher nikaalte hai aap aur log uchaalte hai naam mera', 'Paan roz aakar udhaar khate ho ... aur uspe turrah yeh ke batwa chupate ho', 'Shabash barkhurdar, noor chasham, rahat-e-jaan ... tum chamkaoge apne ustad ka naam']

['Bholi bhali shakal waale hote hai jallad se ... bewafaaon se pyar kaun kare, husn ka aitbaar kaun kare', 'Kahan hai woh ladki jiske daaman mein mooh chupakar insaan sari duniya ko bhool sake ... kahan hai woh ladki jise dekhkar mann bol uthe, is paar yeh madhu hai, tum ho, us paar na jaane kya hoga ... kahan hai woh ladki jise dekhte hi yeh mehsoos ho, ki jise main janam janam se dhoond raha hoon woh yahi hai ... kahan hai woh ladki jiske baare mein Tagore ne kaha tha, teri neeli aankhen ek gehri jheel ki tarah hai, jee chahta hai main un mein doob doob jaon ... kahan hai woh ladki joh mere saath sagar ki machalti lehron mein kood padegi, kahan hai woh ladki joh mere saath jayegi', 'Deewana banana hai toh deewana bana de ... varna kahin taqdeer tamasha na bana de', 'Main bolonga toh bologi ki bolta hai', 'Insaan toh paon se chalta hai ... lekin unhe chalane waala hota hai dil']

['Pyar ek jazbe ka naam hai joh insaan ke mann mein hota hai', 'Woh sab kuch joh mujhe nahi kehna chahiye tha main tumse hamesha kehta raha ... ab jab kuch kehna chahta hoon toh kuch keh nahi pa raha hoon', 'Duniya ek dhol zaroor hai lekin awaaz bajane waale ke haath mein hai ... jaisa haath vaisi awaaz', 'Har maa ke dil ke kisi kone mein ek bahu chupi hoti hai ... joh ek din haathon mein kadhe, paon mein chhade ... cham-cham karti chali aati hai']

['Duniya kitni choti hai ... lekin do aadmiyon ke beech ka faasle kitne lambe ho sakte hai ... kitne bhayanak aur kitne kaale', 'Pyar duniya ki sabse khoobsurat sachai hai', 'Aadmi jab sant banta hai toh jaat paat, oonch neech, Hindu Muslim, desh videsh, rang nasal ke tamaam bedh bhav bhool jaata hai', 'Kahi bar marna aasaan malum hota hai aur jeena mushkil']

['Taqdeerein badal jaati hai, zamana badal jaata hai, mulkon ki tarikh badal jaati hai, Shahenshah badal jaate hai ... magar is badalti hui duniya mein mohabbat jis insaan ka daaman thaam leti hai ... woh insaan nahi badalta', 'Mohabbat joh darti ho woh mohabbat nahin ... ayyashi hai, gunaah hai', 'Mohabbat humne maana zindagi barbad kar deti hai ... yeh kya kam hai ki marr jaane pe duniya yaad karti hai', 'Phool toh murjha jaate hain ... lekin kaante daaman thaam lete hain', 'Duniya mein dilwale ka saath dena ... daulat waale ka nahi', 'Salim tujhe marne nahi dega ... aur hum Anarkali tujhe jeene nahi denge', 'Main tumhari aankhon mein apni mohabbat ka ikraar dekhna chahta hoon', 'Mera dil bhi apka koi Hindustan nahi ... jispar aap hukumat kare', 'Kaaton ko murjhane ka khauf nahin hota', 'Mera jism zaroor zakhmi hai ... lekin meri himmat zakhmi nahi', 'Hamara Hindustan koi tumhara dil nahi ... ki laundi jiski Malika bane', 'Meri aankhon se mere khwab na cheeniye Shehzaade ... main marr jaongi', 'Mohabbat karne waalo ka bas itna hi hai afsana ... tadapna chupke chupke, aah bharna, ghutke marr jana', 'Tahkhane ke bhaari darwaaze talwaron se nahi taqdeeron se khula karte hai', 'Taj un saron par nahin rehta jinke kareeb khauf aa jaye', 'Rajput jaan harta hai ... vachan nahi harta']

['Tum chokri log ka yahi toh musibat hai ... haar shringaar mein aadhi zindagi apni aur intezar mein aadhi zindagi doosre ka barbaad kar deta hai', 'Aaj ka kaam kal karo, kal ka kaam parso ... itni jaldi kya hai, jab jeena hai barso']

['Achcha dost aur achcha pati ... kismat waalon ko hi milta hai', 'Marzi ho toh sooli par chadana ya rab ... sau baar jahannam mein jalana ya rab ... lekin mashooq kahen aap hamare hai buzurg ... na cheez ko yeh din na dikhana ya rab', 'Jis insaan ko maa ki mamta naseeb nahi hui ... us jaisa koi badnaseeb nahi', 'Yahi hai zindagi apni, yahi hai bandagi apni ... ki unka naam aaya aur gardan jhuk gayi apni ... na bhut khane ko jaate hai, na kaabe mein bhatakte hai ... jahan tum paon rakhte ho, vahan hum sar patakte hai ... hum ishq ke maaron ka itna hi fasana hai ... rone ko nahi koi, hasne ko zamana hai', 'Achcha dost aur achchi patni ... kismat waalon ko hi milti hai', 'Tum aa rahi ho zamane ki aankh se bachkar ... nazar jhukaye hue aur badan churaye hue ... khud apne kadamon ki aahat se jhebti, darti ... khud apne saaye ki jumbish se khauf khaye hue']

['Jinka intezar hota hai woh kahan milte hai ... aur jinko khawab mein bhi na socha ho woh baar baar milte hai', 'Sangeet cheez hi aaisi hai ... joh us mein kho nahi jaata woh usse paa bhi nahi sakta', 'Akhiyan bhool gayi hai sona ... dil par hua hai jadoo tona']

['Insaan har cheez se door bhaag sakta hai ... lekin apni kismat se nahi', 'Ulte seedhe daanv lagaye ... hans hans phenka paasa ... arre bhagya ki chaal bhi dekh deewane ... kaisa tujhko phaansa', 'Film line ki yahi reet hai ... naam aur shohrat milte bhale hi der lag jaaye ... naam aur nishaan mitate der nahi lagti', 'Filmy duniya mein insaan ek baar gira ... toh girta hi jaata hai']
['Joh insaan kamzori ka shikaar hoke gir jaye ... woh insaan, insaan nahi rehta', 'Khoob parda hai ke chilman se lage baithe hai ... saaf chupte bhi nahi, samne aate bhi nahi']

['In chikni zulf ke phandon se saadi chotiyan achi hai ... aji bahar ke halwon se ghar ki rotiyan achi hai', 'Nasha hai angoori aankhon mein ... nasha gulaabi gaalon mein ... arri haseena, nasha kahan hai in mitti ke pyaalon mein', 'Dil ki chupi umangon ko mat band rakho kabhi taalon mein ... lo hothon ki pyaas bhuja lo, nasha jhalakta pyaalon mein', 'Chamkenge lakh chanda, yeh raat phir na aaye ... hongi hazar baatein, yeh baat phir na aaye', 'Aa dil se dil mila le, is dil mein ghar basa le, aaja gale laga le ... o rasiya, mann basiya, dil mila le, dil mila le', 'Arri na pooch tabiyat badzaat ka raaz ... joh dekhta hoon dikhai nahi deta, joh sochta hoon samajh mein nahi aata']

['Jis dhan ke liye aap duniya se dokha kar rahe hai, apne azeezon se, apne doston se dokha kar rahe hai, apne saathiyon se dokha kar rahe hai ... ussi dhan ke haathon aap khud bhi dokha khayenge', 'Agar woh bechara ek din kaam par nahi jaata ... toh us bechare ke ghar mein chula nahi jalta ... aur jis din chula nahi jalta ... uska pet jalta hai, uski aatma jalti hai', 'Agar aaj hum sab aapas mein milkar aur apne kaam ko apna dharam samajhkar kare ... toh kal hamara desh bhi duniya ke sare mulkon ke aage apna sar ooncha karke khada ho sakega', 'Insaan patthar ki chot seh sakta hai ... lekin yeh buri nazar ke vaar se bachna bahut mushkil hai', 'Insaan apne maa baap ke naam se nahi ... apne ghuno se achcha ya bura samjha jaata hai', 'Rupaiya kya hai? ... mitti ki tarah ek bejaan aur bekaar cheez hai ... lekin jis tarah mitti mein mehnat ka beejh ugaye bagair paidawar nahi ho sakti  ... ussi tarah rupaiya ke saath jab tak mehnat ka mel nahi hoga ... duniya mein kabhi koi tarakki nahi kar sakega', 'Pet ki awaaz ke samne aatma aur parmatma dono ki awaaz gayab ho jaati hai', 'Hum toh sirf yeh chahte hai sethji ... ki hamara aur aapka amir ya garib ka rishta na rahe ... malik ya mazdoor ka rishta na rahe ... balki hum dono ke darmiyan ek insaan aur insaan ka rishta kayam ho', 'Kisi insaan ka yun khatam hona achcha nahi ... khatam toh honi chahiye uski burai, uska chotapan, uski khudgarzi', 'Mohabbat kisi ke kehne se nahi ki jaati aur na kisi ke hukum se todi ja sakti hai']

['Baimaani ke chocolate se imaandari ki chane hazar gunah zyada achche hai', 'Jab main dushmani pe utar aata hoon ... toh insaan ko pataal mein bhi chain naseeb nahi hota', 'Mehnat se din raat padhoonga ... pehla number pass karoonga', 'Toofano se nahi daroonga ... himmat se main nikal padhoonga', 'Insaan ki zindagi tarazu ka ek palhada hai ... joh kabhi upar aur kabhi neeche', 'Hindustan ki shaan banoonga ... desh ka ooncha naam karoonga', 'Aatma gandi hone se aadmi ke chehre par bhi laanat baratne lagti hai', 'Insaan burai chahe khud kare ya kisi ke kehne par kare ... magar burai, burai hi rehti hai']
